fields.title: Ennyinyonnyola Ennyangu ey’Okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo
fields.subtitle: Nga John Wesley bwe Yakukkiriza era bwe Yakuyigiriza
fields.description: John Wesley yennyini annyonnyola, mu bye yakuŋŋaanya okumala emyaka amakumi ataano, kye yategeezanga ne kye yali tategeeza mu kutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo: si kuwonyezebwa nsobi, butamanya oba bunafu, wabula omutima ogujjudde okwagala eri Katonda n’eri muliraanwa ne kiba nti tewasigalamu kintu kikontana nakwo. Kye kinnyonnyola ekisingayo okweyoleka eky’enjigiriza eyafuula Abametodisiti kye baali.

qa.question: Ekitabo “Ennyinyonnyola Ennyangu ey’Okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo” kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kye kinnyonnyola John Wesley yennyini kye yakuŋŋaanya okumala emyaka amakumi ataano, ku kye yategeezanga ne kye yali tategeeza mu kutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo. Yeegendereza okunnyonnyola nti tategeeza kuwonyezebwa nsobi, butamanya, oba bunafu, wabula omutima ogujjudde okwagala eri Katonda n’eri muliraanwa ne kiba nti tewasigalamu kintu kyonna kikontana n’okwagala — enjigiriza enkulu era eyawakanyizibwa ennyo eyali wakati mu kibiina ky’Abametodisiti.

qa.question: John Wesley yali ani?
qa.answer: John Wesley ye yatandikawo Abametodisiti mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omunaana, kabona w’Ekkanisa ya England, eyabuulira n’okutegeka awatali kukoowa, n’ayamba okukoleeza okuzuukuka okunene mu Bungereza. Okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo, oba okutukuzibwa okujjuvu, kye kimu ku bye yayigiriza ebyamwawula ennyo era ebyawakanyizibwa ennyo, era ekitabo kino kye kirwanirira n’ekinnyonnyola kye yawandiika ng’akuze, n’obwegendereza.

qa.question: Wesley ategeeza ki mu ‘kutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo’?
qa.answer: Ategeeza okwagala okutuukiridde — omutima ogwewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda n’eri muliraanwa, ogunaaziddwako obuyinza bw’ekibi obufuga, okwagala ne kufuuka etteeka erifuga obulamu bwonna. Akakasa nti si kwe kwegamba nti omuntu talina nsobi yonna wadde nti yawonyezebwa obunafu bw’obuntu, wabula okujjula kw’okwagala kwe yakkiriza nti Katonda ayinza okukola mu mukkiriza mu bulamu buno.

qa.question: Wesley agamba nti okutuukirira SI kiki?
qa.answer: Ku kino anywerera nnyo. Okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo tekutegeeza kuwonyezebwa butamanya, nsobi, bunafu, oba kukemebwa; omukkiriza atuukirizibwa akyakola ensobi era akyetaaga Kristo buli kaseera. Wesley yawandiika ekitundu ekinene eky’ekitabo okuggyawo obutategeera buno, ng’anywerera ku kuba nti ategeeza okutuukirira mu kwagala, so si butabaako kamogo n’akatono, ekitasoboka mu bulamu buno.

qa.question: Lwaki enjigiriza eno yawakanyizibwa?
qa.answer: Kubanga abaagiwakanya baatya nti yeegamba okutuukirira okutaliimu kibi Ebyawandiikibwa kwe byegaana mu bulamu buno, oba nti yazaala amalala n’okwerimba. Wesley yamala emyaka mingi ng’agirwanirira era ng’agirongoosa ng’addamu ebiwakanya ng’ebyo, era eyo y’emu ku nsonga lwaki ekitabo kiyitibwa ‘ennyinyonnyola ennyangu’ — okugezaako okunnyonnyola n’obwegendereza, n’okukuuma obutakozesebwa bubi, enjigiriza bangi gye baalaba nga tesoboka oba ng’ey’akabi.

qa.question: Wesley agamba nti okutuukirira kufunibwa kutya?
qa.answer: Olw’okukkiriza, ng’omulimu gw’ekisa kya Katonda, emirundi mingi okufunibwa mu kaseera kamu newakubadde nga kuteekebwateekebwa okumala ekiseera — si kufunibwa lwa kufuba kwa muntu, wabula kukolebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu mutima ogwewaddeyo ddala. Wesley yayigiriza abakkiriza okukunoonya n’amaanyi n’okukusuubira, nga beesigama ku Kristo bulijjo, era n’okukutwala ng’ekirabo kya Katonda so si kye batuuseeko bo bennyini.

qa.question: Ani asaanidde okusoma ekitabo kino?
qa.answer: Buli ayagala okutegeera Wesley n’Abametodisiti mu nsibuko yaabwe ddala, oba enkola y’obutukuvu eyava gy’ali, na buli Mukristaayo assa omwoyo ku kunoonya obutukuvu n’okwagala okutuukiridde. Kyetaagisa ddala okutegeera enjigiriza eyakola ebibiina ebiramba, era kya mugaso eri buli ayagala okupima Ebyawandiikibwa bye bisuubiza omukkiriza mu bulamu buno.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanidde kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa; ekitabo kisengekeddwa okusinga nga Wesley yennyini bw’annyonnyola ebyaliwo mu nsengeka y’ebiseera, ng’alaga engeri okutegeera kwe gye kwakulamu era ng’addamu ebiwakanya mu kkubo. Bw’okisoma mu nsengeka yaakyo, kikusobozesa okulaba enjigiriza ng’efuna ekifaananyi mu mikono gya Wesley, n’okutegeera kye yakakasa ne kye yeegendereza okwegaana.

fields.title: Ebitundu 1-7
fields.body_html:
1. Kye ngenderera mu biwandiiko bino ebiddirira kwe kunnyonnyola mu lwatu era mu ngeri etegeerekeka amadaala ge nnayitamu, mu bbanga ery’emyaka emingi, okutuuka okukkiriza enjigiriza y’okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo. Kino nkibanja abantu abassa omwoyo ku by’eddiini, abo abaagala okumanya “amazima nga bwe gali mu Yesu” gonna. Era abo bokka be bafaayo ku bibuuzo ng’ebyo. Abo nandyagadde okubategeeza ensonga nga bw’eri, awatali kugibikkako, nga ngezaako buli kiseera okulaga, okuva ku mulembe ogumu okutuuka ku mulala, bye nnalowoozanga era n’ensonga lwaki nnabirowoozanga.

2. Mu mwaka 1725, nga ndi mu mwaka gwange ogw’amakumi abiri mu esatu, nnasanga ekitabo kya Omulabirizi Taylor ekiyitibwa “Amateeka n’Okwegezaamu mu Kubeera n’Okufa mu Butukuvu.” Bwe nnasoma ebitundu byakyo ebitali bimu, ne nkwatibwako nnyo; naddala ekitundu ekyogera ku bulongoofu bw’ekigendererwa. Amangu ago ne nsalawo okuwaayo obulamu bwange bwonna eri Katonda, ebirowoozo byange byonna, n’ebigambo, n’ebikolwa; nga nkakasizza ddala nti tewali kkubo lya wakati; wabula nti buli kitundu ky’obulamu bwange (so si ebimu byokka) kiteekwa okuba ssaddaaka eri Katonda, oba eri nze kennyini, kwe kugamba, mu butuufu, eri Setaani.

Waliwo omuntu yenna assa omwoyo ku by’eddiini ayinza okubuusabuusa kino, oba okuzuula ekkubo erya wakati wakati w’okuweereza Katonda n’okuweereza Setaani?

3. Mu mwaka 1726, nnasanga ekitabo kya Kempis, “Ekyokulabirako ky’Omukristaayo.” Embeera n’obunene bw’eddiini ey’omunda, eddiini ey’omutima, kaakano ne birabikira mu musana ogusinga obungi okusinga bwe gwali gubirabikiddemu emabega. Nnalaba nti okuwaayo n’obulamu bwange bwonna eri Katonda (bwe kiba nti kisoboka okukikola, ne sigenda wala okusingawo tekyandingasizza n’akatono, okuggyako nga mmuwadde omutima gwange, weewaawo, omutima gwange gwonna.

Nnalaba nti “obwangu bw’ekigendererwa, n’obulongoofu bw’okwagala,” ekigendererwa kimu mu byonna bye twogera oba bye tukola, n’okwegomba kumu nga kufuga empisa zaffe zonna, ddala “bye biwaawaatiro by’emmeeme,” awatali byo teyinza n’akatono kulinnya ku lusozi lwa Katonda.

4. Oluvannyuma lw’omwaka gumu oba ebiri, ne bampa ebitabo by’Omwami Law, “Okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo” ne “Okuyita okw’Amaanyi.” Bino byankakasa, okusinga bwe kyali kibadde, nti tekisoboka n’akatono okubeera Omukristaayo ow’ekitundu; ne nsalawo, ku bw’ekisa kye, (kye nnali ntegeera ennyo nti kyetaagisa ddala;) okwewaayo ddala eri Katonda, okumuwa emmeeme yange yonna, omubiri gwange, n’ebintu byange

Waliwo omuntu yenna ow’amagezi agenda okugamba nti kino kugenda wala nnyo? oba nti waliwo ekitono ku kino kye tubanjibwa Oyo eyeewaayo ku lwaffe, okuggyako okumuwa ffe ffennyini, byonna bye tulina, ne byonna bye tuli?

5. Mu mwaka 1729, ne ntandika obutasoma busomi, wabula okwekenneenya Bayibuli, nga gwe mutindo ogumu, ogwokka ogw’amazima, era ekyokulabirako kyokka eky’eddiini ennongoofu. Kale ne ndaba, mu musana ogweyongera okwaka, nti kyetaagisa ddala okubeeramu “endowooza eri eyali mu Kristo,” n’“okutambula nga Kristo bwe yatambula;” weewaawo, okubeeramu, si ekitundu kyokka, wabula endowooza yonna eyali mu ye; n’okutambula nga ye bwe yatambula, si mu ngeri nnyingi zokka oba mu ezisinga obungi, wabula mu byonna. Era guno gwe musana mwe nnatunuuliranga eddiini mu kiseera ekyo, ng’okugoberera Kristo mu ngeri etakyukakyuka, okufaanana Mukama waffe mu bujjuvu munda ne kungulu. Era tewaaliwo kye nnatyanga okusinga okukyusakyusa etteeka lino okulisengeka ku bye nnayitamu nze kennyini; oba ku by’abantu abalala; oba okwekkiriza okubaako ne akatono akasinga obutono ke saafaanana Ekyokulabirako kyaffe ekikulu.

6. Nga Janwali 1, 1733, nnabuulira mu maaso ga Yunivasite mu kkanisa ya St. Mary, ku “Kukomolebwa kw’Omutima;” ne nnyonnyola nti: “Gy’embeera y’emmeeme ey’olubeerera, mu biwandiiko ebitukuvu, eyitibwa obutukuvu; era etegeeza butereevu okunaazibwako ekibi ‘mu buli kintu ekyonoona omubiri n’omwoyo;’ era, okuva ku ekyo, okuweebwa empisa ennungi ezaali mu Kristo Yesu okufuulibwa ‘abaggya mu ndowooza zaffe,’ ne tuba ‘abatuukirivu nga Kitaffe ali mu ggulu bw’ali Omutuukirivu.”’ (Vol. V., p. 203.)

Mu bubaka obwo bwe bumu nnagamba nti, ”‘Okwagala kwe kutuukiriza amateeka, era kye kigendererwa ky’ekiragiro.’ Si kiragiro ‘ekisooka era ekikulu’ kyokka, wabula biragiro byonna mu kimu. ‘Buli kya mazima, buli kirongoofu, bwe wabangawo ekirungi, bwe wabangawo ettendo,’ byonna bigattiddwa mu kigambo kino kimu, okwagala. Mu kino mwe muli okutuukirira, n’ekitiibwa, n’essanyu: Etteeka ery’obwakabaka ery’eggulu n’ensi lye lino, ‘Yagalanga Mukama Katonda wo n’omutima gwo gwonna, n’omwoyo gwo gwonna, n’amagezi go gonna, n’amaanyi go gonna.’ Ekirungi ekimu ekituukiridde kye kinaabanga ekigendererwa kyammwe kimu eky’enkomerero. Ekintu kimu kye mulyegombanga ku lwakyo kyokka,—okunyumirwa Oyo ali byonna mu byonna. Essanyu limu lye mulisaanidde okuteekerawo emmeeme zammwe, kwe kwegatta n’Oyo eyazitonda, okubeera ‘n’okussa ekimu ne Kitaffe n’Omwana,’ okubeera ‘abeegatta ne Mukama mu mwoyo gumu.’ Ekigendererwa kimu kye mulina okugoberera okutuuka ku nkomerero y’ebiseera,—okunyumirwa Katonda mu biseera bino ne mu biseera ebitaggwaawo. Mwegombe ebintu ebirala okutuuka we bituusa ku kino; mwagale ekitonde nga bwe kikutuusa ku Mutonzi. Naye mu buli kigere kye mutambula, kino kibeere ekifo eky’ekitiibwa ekikoma okulaba kwammwe. Buli kwegomba, na buli kirowoozo na kigambo, na kikolwa, bifugibwe kino. Buli kye mwegomba oba kye mutya, buli kye munoonya oba kye mwewala, buli kye mulowooza kye mwogera, oba kye mukola, kibeere olw’essanyu lyammwe mu Katonda, ekigendererwa kyokka, era ensibuko, ey’obulamu bwammwe.” (Ibid., pp. 207, 208.)

Nnakomekkereza n’ebigambo bino: “Guno gwe mugatte gw’etteeka erituukiridde, okukomolebwa kw’omutima. Omwoyo gukomewo eri Katonda eyagugaba, n’okwagala kwagwo kwonna kwe gutambula nakwo.—Ssaddaaka endala okuva gye tuli teyazaagala, naye ssaddaaka ennamu ey’omutima gy’eyalonda. Eweebwenga Katonda obutayosa ku bwa Kristo, mu bulimi bw’okwagala okutukuvu. So tewabanga kitonde kikkirizibwa kugabana naye; kubanga ye Katonda wa buggya. Entebe ye ey’obwakabaka tagenda kugigabana na mulala; alifuga awatali amuvuganya. Tewabanga kigendererwa, wadde okwegomba okukkirizibwa omwo, okuggyako ekyo ekirina Ye ng’ekigendererwa kyakyo eky’enkomerero. Lino lye kkubo abaana ba Katonda abo mwe baatambulira edda, abaafa naye nga bakyayogera naffe: ’Toyagala kubeera mulamu okuggyako okutendereza erinnya lye; ebirowoozo byo byonna, n’ebigambo, n’ebikolwa bigenderere ekitiibwa kye.’ ‘Emmeeme yo ejjule okwagala okujjuvu ennyo eri Ye, n’oleme kwagala kintu kyonna okuggyako ku lulwe.’ ’Beera n’ekigendererwa ekirongoofu eky’omutima, n’okufaayo okunywevu ku kitiibwa kye mu bikolwa byo byonna.’ Kubanga olwo, so si nga olwo terunnatuuka, ‘endowooza eyali mu Kristo Yesu’ ebeera mu ffe, bwe tuba nga mu buli kunyeenya kw’omutima gwaffe, mu buli kigambo eky’olulimi lwaffe, mu buli mulimu gw’emikono gyaffe, ‘tetunoonya kintu kyonna okuggyako ekikwatagana naye, era nga kigondera by’asiima;’ bwe tuba nga naffe tetulowooza, wadde okwogera, wadde okukola, okutuukiriza ‘bye twagala ffe ku bwaffe, wabula Oyo eyatutuma by’ayagala;’ bwe tuba nga, ‘oba tulya oba tunywa, oba buli kye tukola,’ byonna tubikola ‘olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda.”’ (Ibid., p. 211.)

Kiyinza okulabika nti obubaka buno bwe bwasooka okuwandiikibwa mu biwandiiko byange byonna ebyafulumizibwa. Eno ye ndaba gye nnali nnina ku ddiini mu kiseera ekyo, era ne mu kiseera ekyo sseetya kugiyita okutuukirira. Eno ye ndaba gye nnina ku yo kaakano, awatali kugattako oba kukendeezaako kintu kikulu kyonna. Era kiki ekiri wano omuntu yenna ow’amagezi, akkiriza Bayibuli, ky’ayinza okuwakanya? Kiki ky’ayinza okwegaana, nga tawakanyizza Ebyawandiikibwa mu lwatu? kiki ky’ayinza okusalako, nga taggye ku kigambo kya Katonda?

7. Mu ndowooza eyo yennyini mwe twasigala nze ne muganda wange (wamu n’abavubuka abo bonna abaayitibwanga mu kunyoomebwa Abametodisiti) okutuusa lwe twasaabala okugenda e America, ku nkomerero y’omwaka 1735. Mu mwaka ogwaddako, nga ndi e Savannah, ne mpandiika ennyiriri zino wammanga:—

Waliwo ekintu kyonna wansi w’enjuba,

Ekirwanagana naawe okugabana omutima gwange?

Ayi! kikuulemu, ofuge wekka,

Mukama wa buli kunyeenya kwagwo!

Ku ntandikwa y’omwaka 1738, nga nkomawo okuva eyo, okukaaba kw’omutima gwange kwali,

Ayi, kkiriza obutabaawo kintu mu mmeeme yange

Ekibeeramu, okuggyako okwagala kwo okulongoofu kwokka!

Ayi, okwagala kwo kunjijule nnyenna,

Essanyu lyange, obugagga bwange, n’engule yange !

Omuliro ogw’ekitalo guggye wala ku mutima gwange;

Buli kikolwa kyange, kigambo, kirowoozo, bibeere kwagala!

Sseewulirangako nti waliwo eyawakanya kino. Era ddala ani ayinza okukiwakanya? Kino si lwe lulimi, si lwa buli mukkiriza lwokka, wabula olwa buli muntu yenna azuukusiddwa ddala? Naye kiki kye mpandiise, okutuusa leero, ekisinga kino amaanyi oba okutegeerekeka?

fields.title: Ebitundu 8-14
fields.body_html:
8. Mu Agusito eyaddirira, nnanyumya ebbanga ddene ne Arvid Gradin, mu Bugirimaani. Bwe yamala okunnyonnyola bye yali ayiseemu, ne mmusaba ampe, mu buwandiike, amakulu g’“obukakafu obujjuvu obw’okukkiriza,” n’abiwandiika mu bigambo bino:—

_Requies in sanguine Christi; firma fiducia in Deum, et persuasio de gratia divina; tranquillitas mentis summa, atque serenitas et pax; cum absentia omnis desiderii carnalis, et cessatione peccatorum etiam internorum.

“Okuwummulira mu musaayi gwa Kristo; okwesiga Katonda okunywevu, n’okukakasa nti akusiima; obukkakkamu bw’omutima obusingayo, n’obuteefu, n’emirembe, awamu n’okununulibwa mu buli kwegomba kwa mubiri, n’okukoma kw’ebibi byonna, ne bw’ebiba eby’omunda.”

Guno gwe mulundi ogwasooka okuwulira okuva ku muntu omulamu yenna, ekyo kye nnali nsoose okuyiga nze kennyini okuva mu bigambo bya Katonda, era kye nnali nsaba, (wamu n’akabinja akatono ak’emikwano gyange,) era kye nnali nsuubira, okumala emyaka egiwerako.

9. Mu 1739, nze ne muganda wange twafulumya ekitabo eky’“Ennyimba n’Ebitontome Ebitukuvu.” Mu bingi ku byo twalangirira endowooza zaffe n’amaanyi era mu lwatu. Bwe kiti, ku lupapula 24,—

Kyusa omugga gwonna ogw’obutonde bwaffe;

Ebikolwa byaffe byonna bigende

Gy’oli, ensibuko yaabyo; okwagala kwo kubikulembere,

Ekitiibwa kyo kibe enkomerero.

Olwo ensi eribeera madaala agalinnya mu ggulu;

Okuwulira kwaffe kulitulaga ekkubo;

Ebitonde byonna birituleeta gy’oli,

Era byonna bye tuloza bibe Katonda.

Ate,—

Mukama, nnyambaza amaanyi g’Omwoyo wo,

Kubanga nnayitibwa erinnya lyo ekkulu:

Mu ggwe ebirowoozo byange ebibungeeta bigatte,

Ggwe obe ekigendererwa ky’emirimu gyange gyonna:

Okwagala kwo kumbeere ennaku zange zonna,

Era omulimu gwange gwokka gubeere kukutendereza. (Olupapula 122.)

Ate,—

Nga nkwegomba nnyo nsaba era mpejjawejja,

Etteeka ery’obwakatonda ery’amaanyi ennyo,

Linsika n’okuwaliriza okunyuvu,

Okutuusa emmeeme yange yonna etukuziddwa lw’eneeba yiyo;

Nga nnyikiddwa mu nnyanja ey’obuziba bw’Obwakatonda,

Era nga mbuze mu bugazi bwo obutakoma! (Olupapula 125.)

Omulundi omulala,—

Adamu ow’omu ggulu, obulamu obw’obwakatonda,

Kyusa obutonde bwange bufuuke bubwo;

Tambula era bunye mu mmeeme yange yonna,

Gikozese era ogijjuze yonna. (Olupapula 153.)

Kyandibadde kyangu okujuliza ebitundu ebirala bingi ebyogera ekintu kye kimu. Naye bino bimala okulaga, awatali kuwakanyizibwa, endowooza zaffe bwe zaali mu kiseera ekyo.

10. Akatabo akaasooka ke nnawandiika nga kagendereddwamu ddala ensonga eno kaafulumizibwa ku nkomerero y’omwaka guno. Waleme kubaawo n’omu asooka okukakyawa nga tannakasoma, ne nkatuuma omutwe ogutaliiko ludda gwe gukwatako ogugamba nti “Empisa z’Omumetodisiti.” Mu kano nnannyonnyola Omukristaayo atuukiridde, nga ku ntandikwa ndiddeko nti, “Si nti mmaze okufuna.” Ekitundu kyako nkigattako wano awatali kukyusa kintu:—

“Omumetodisiti ye muntu ayagala Mukama Katonda we n’omutima gwe gwonna, n’emmeeme ye yonna, n’amagezi ge gonna, n’amaanyi ge gonna. Katonda ge masanyu g’omutima gwe, era kye kyegombebwa ky’emmeeme ye, ekikaaba obutayosa nti, ‘Ani gwe nnina mu ggulu, wabula ggwe? Era tewali na kimu ku nsi kye neetaaga bwe mba naawe.’ Katonda wange era byonna byange! ‘Ggwe maanyi g’omutima gwange, era ggwe mugabo gwange emirembe gyonna.’ N’olwekyo musanyufu mu Katonda; weewaawo, musanyufu bulijjo, kubanga alina mu ye ensulo y’amazzi agakulukuta okutuuka ku bulamu obutaggwaawo, era agabooga emmeeme ye n’emirembe n’essanyu. Okwagala okutuukiridde bwe kumaze okugoba okutya, asanyuka ennaku zonna. Weewaawo, essanyu lye lijjuvu, era amagumba ge gonna gakaaba nti, ‘Atenderezebwe Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, olw’okusaasira kwe okungi eyanzaala omulundi ogwokubiri mu ssuubi eddamu ery’obusika obutavunda era obutaliiko bbala, obunterekeddwa mu ggulu.’

“Era oyo alina essuubi lino, erijjudde obutafa bwe lityo, mu buli kintu yeebaza, kubanga amanyi nti kino (kyonna kye kiba) Katonda ky’amwagaliza mu Kristo Yesu. N’olwekyo byonna abifuna okuva gy’ali n’essanyu, ng’agamba nti, ‘By’ayagala Mukama birungi;’ era oba agaba oba aggyawo, nga yeebaza erinnya lya Mukama mu ngeri y’emu. Oba mu kuwummula oba mu bulumi, oba mu bulwadde oba mu bulamu obulungi, oba mu bulamu oba mu kufa, yeebaza okuva mu ntobo y’omutima Oyo abisengeka olw’obulungi; gwe yakwasa ddala omubiri gwe n’emmeeme ye mu mikono gye, ’ng’omu mikono gy’Omutonzi omwesigwa.’ N’olwekyo ’teyeeraliikirira kintu na kimu,’ kubanga ‘yamutwalira byonna bye yeeraliikirira, Oyo amufaako;’ era ‘mu buli kintu’ amwesigama, ng’amaze ‘okumutegeeza bye yeetaaga n’okwebaza.’

“Kubanga ddala ‘asaba obutayosa;’ buli kiseera olulimi lw’omutima gwe luno, ‘Akamwa kange kali gy’oli, wadde nga tekaliiko ddoboozi; era okusirika kwange kwogera naawe.’ Omutima gwe gusituliddwa eri Katonda buli kiseera, ne mu buli kifo. Mu kino tewali muntu wadde ekintu ekimulemesa, n’okusinga ennyo ekimusalako. Mu kwekweka oba mu bantu, mu kiseera eky’eddembe, mu mirimu, oba mu kunyumya, omutima gwe buli kiseera guli ne Mukama. Oba agalamira, oba agolokoka, ‘Katonda ali mu birowoozo bye byonna:’ Atambula ne Katonda obutayosa; ng’eriiso ery’okwagala ery’emmeeme ye liri ku ye, era buli wantu ‘ng’alaba Oyo atalabika.’

“Era bw’ayagala Katonda, ‘ayagala muliraanwa we nga bwe yeeyagala yekka;’ ayagala buli muntu ng’emmeeme ye ye. Ayagala abalabe be, weewaawo, n’abalabe ba Katonda. Era bwe kiba nti tasobola ‘kukola bulungi abo abamukyawa,’ tayosa ‘kubasabira,’ newakubadde nga bagaana okwagala kwe, era nga bakyali ‘bamukozesa bubi, era nga bamuyigganya.’

“Kubanga ‘alina omutima omulongoofu.’ Okwagala kulongoosezza omutima gwe okuva mu buggya, mu ttima, mu busungu, ne mu buli mpisa etaliimu kisa. Kumunaazizzaako amalala, mwe ‘muva empaka zokka;’ era kaakano ‘ayambadde omwoyo ogusaasira, n’ekisa, n’obuwombeefu, n’obuteefu, n’obugumiikiriza.’ Era ddala buli nsonga eyinza okuleeta empaka ku ludda lwe esaliddwako. Kubanga tewali ayinza kumuggyako ky’ayagala, kubanga ‘tayagala nsi, wadde eby’ensi;’ naye ‘okwegomba kwe kwonna kuli eri Katonda, n’eri okujjukira erinnya lye.’

“Ng’ekikwatagana n’okwegomba kwe kuno okumu, kye kigendererwa kye kino ekimu eky’obulamu bwe; kwe kugamba, ‘okukola, si by’ayagala ye, wabula Oyo eyamutuma by’ayagala.’ Ekigendererwa kye ekimu buli kiseera ne mu buli kifo, si kwesanyusa yekka, wabula kusanyusa Oyo emmeeme ye gw’eyagala. Alina eriiso eddamu; era kubanga ‘eriiso lye ddamu, omubiri gwe gwonna gujjula omusana. Gwonna musana, ng’ekitangaala eky’ettaala bwe kimulisa ennyumba.’ Katonda yekka y’afuga; byonna ebiri mu mmeeme ‘butukuvu eri Mukama.’ Tewali kunyeenya kwonna mu mutima gwe okutali nga by’ayagala bwe biri. Buli kirowoozo ekijja kimusonga, era kiri mu ‘kugondera etteeka lya Kristo.’

“Era omuti gumanyibwa olw’ebibala byagwo. Kubanga, nga bw’ayagala Katonda, bw’atyo ’akwata ebiragiro bye;’ si ebimu byokka, oba ebisinga obungi, wabula byonna, okuva ku kisinga obutono okutuuka ku kisinga obunene. Tamatira ‘kukwata mateeka gonna n’asobyako erimu,’ naye mu byonna alina ‘omwoyo omulongoofu eri Katonda, n’eri abantu.’ Kyonna Katonda ky’agaana, akyewala; kyonna Katonda ky’alagira, akikola. ‘Adduka mu kkubo ly’ebiragiro bya Katonda,’ kaakano Ye ng’asumuludde omutima gwe. Kye kitiibwa kye era lye ssanyu lye okukola bw’atyo; ye ngule ye eya buli lunaku ey’okusanyuka, okukola ‘Katonda by’ayagala ku nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu.’

“Ebiragiro bya Katonda byonna bw’atyo abikwata, era n’amaanyi ge gonna; kubanga obuwulize bwe bwenkana okwagala kwe, ensibuko mwe buva. N’olwekyo, bw’ayagala Katonda n’omutima gwe gwonna, amuweereza n’amaanyi ge gonna; obutayosa awaayo emmeeme ye n’‘omubiri gwe nga ssaddaaka ennamu, entukuvu, esanyusa Katonda;’ nga yeewaayo ddala awatali kwesigaliza, ye kennyini, byonna by’alina, ne byonna by’ali, olw’ekitiibwa kye. Ebitone byonna by’alina, abikozesa obutayosa nga Mukama we bw’ayagala; buli maanyi na buli busobozi bw’emmeeme ye, na buli kitundu ky’omubiri gwe.

“N’olwekyo, ‘buli ky’akola, byonna biba lwa kitiibwa kya Katonda.’ Mu mirimu gye gyonna egya buli ngeri, takoma ku kukigenderera kyokka, ekitegeezebwa mu kubeera n’eriiso eddamu, wabula akituukako ddala; emirimu gye n’okuwummula kwe, awamu n’okusaba kwe, byonna biweereza ekigendererwa kino ekikulu. Oba ‘atudde mu nnyumba, oba atambula mu kkubo,’ oba agalamira, oba agolokoka, mu byonna by’ayogera oba by’akola, atumbula omulimu gumu ogw’obulamu bwe. Oba ayambala engoye ze, oba akola, oba alya n’anywa, oba yeewummuza okuva ku mirimu egimukooya ennyo, byonna bigenderera okukuza ekitiibwa kya Katonda, okuyita mu mirembe n’okwagaliza abantu ebirungi. Etteeka lye erimu eritakyuka lye lino: ‘Na buli kye munaakolanga mu kigambo oba mu kikolwa, byonna mubikolenga mu linnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu nga muyita mu ye okwebaza Katonda Kitaffe.’

“So n’empisa z’ensi tezimulemesa n’akatono ’ okudduka embiro ezaamutegekerwa.’ N’olwekyo tayinza ‘kweterekera byabugagga ku nsi,’ okusinga bw’ayinza okuteeka omuliro mu kifuba kye. Tayinza kwogera bubi ku muliraanwa we, okusinga bw’ayinza okulimba ku lwa Katonda oba ku lw’omuntu. Tayinza kwogera kigambo kitaliimu kisa ku muntu yenna; kubanga okwagala kukuuma oluggi lw’emimwa gye. Tayinza ‘kwogera bigambo bya bwereere; tewali kunyumya kuvundu’ ‘kuva mu kamwa ke;’ nga bwe biri byonna ebitali ‘birungi okuzimba,’ ebitasaana ‘kugasa abo ababiwulira.’ Naye ’buli kirongoofu, buli kyagalibwa, buli kyogerwako’ mu butuufu ‘obulungi,’ ekyo ky’alowooza, ky’ayogera, era ky’akola, ’ng’ayonjeza okuyigiriza kwa Katonda Omulokozi waffe mu byonna.’”

Bino bye bigambo byennyini mwe nnasooka okulangirira mu bujjuvu endowooza zange ku kutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo. Era si kyangu okulaba, (1.) Nti kino kye kifo kyennyini kye nnagenderera ebbanga lyonna okuva mu mwaka 1725; era n’amaanyi agasingako okuva mu mwaka 1730, bwe nnatandika okubeera homo unius libri, “omuntu ow’ekitabo kimu,” nga sifaayo ku kirala kyonna, bw’ogeraageranya, okuggyako Bayibuli? Si kyangu okulaba, (2.) Nti eno ye njigiriza yennyini gye nzikiriza era gye njigiriza leero; nga sigasseeko nsonga n’emu, ku butukuvu obw’omunda wadde obw’okungulu bwe nnalwanirira emyaka amakumi asatu mu munaana egiyise? Era y’emu gye nneyongedde okuyigiriza, ku bw’ekisa kya Katonda, okuva mu kiseera ekyo okutuusa kaakano; nga bwe kirirabika eri buli muntu atasaliriza okuva mu bitundu ebigattiddwako wammanga.

11. Simanyi nti waliwo omuwandiisi yenna eyawakanyizza akatabo ako okutuusa leero; era okumala ekiseera, saasanga kuwakanyizibwa kungi ku nsonga eyo, waakiri, si okuva ku bantu abassa omwoyo ku by’eddiini. Naye oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, okukaaba ne kugolokoka, era, ekyanneewuunyisa katono, mu bantu ab’eddiini, abaagamba, si nti nnannyonnyola okutuukirira obubi, wabula nti “tewali kutuukirira ku nsi;” weewaawo, ne batulumba n’amaanyi nze ne muganda wange olw’okugamba ekikontana n’ekyo. Twali tetusuubira kulumbibwa bwe kutyo okw’amaanyi okuva ku bano; naddala kubanga twali bannyonnyofu ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza, era nga twegendereza okuwa obulokozi bwonna ekisa kya Katonda kyokka. Naye ekyasinga okutwewuunyisa, kwe kugambibwa nti “tuswaza Kristo,” olw’okugamba nti “alokolera ddala;” olw’okulwanirira nti alifuga mu mitima gyaffe yekka, era alifuga byonna bimugondere.

12. Ndowooza nti kyali ku nkomerero y’omwaka 1740, bwe nnanyumya ne Dr. Gibson, eyali Omulabirizi w’e London mu kiseera ekyo, e Whitehall. Yambuuza kye ntegeeza ku kutuukirira. Ne mmugamba awatali kukweka wadde okwesigaliza. Bwe nnamala okwogera, n’agamba nti, “Omwami Wesley, bwe kiba nti kino kyokka ky’otegeeza, kifulumye eri ensi yonna. Olwo omuntu yenna bw’aba ayinza okuwakanya ky’oyogera, kimugguliddwawo.” Ne mmuddamu nti, “Mukama wange, nja kukikola;” era bwe ntyo ne mpandiika era ne nfulumya obubaka ku kutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo.

Mu bwo nnagezaako okulaga, (1.) Mu makulu ki Abakristaayo mwe batali, (2.) Mu makulu ki mwe bali, abatuukiridde.

“(1.) Mu makulu ki mwe batali. Tebatuukiridde mu kumanya. Tebaawukana na butamanya, nedda, wadde okukola ensobi. Tetulina kusuubira muntu yenna mulamu kubeera atasobya, okusinga bwe tusuubira okubeera amanyi byonna. Tebaawukana na bunafu, ng’obunafu oba obulwa mu kutegeera, oba okwanguwa okutali kwa bulijjo oba obuzito mu kulowooza. Obwa ngeri endala bwe buno: okwogera ebitasaana, n’okwatula ebigambo mu ngeri etali nnungi; era omuntu ayinza okugattako obunafu obulala lukumi obutaliiko mannya, oba mu kunyumya oba mu nneeyisa. Okuva mu bunafu ng’obwo tewali awonyezebwa ddala okutuusa emyoyo gyabwe lwe gikomawo eri Katonda; era tetuyinza kusuubira okutuusa olwo okuwonyezebwa ddala okukemebwa; kubanga ‘omuddu tasinga mukama we.’ Naye ne mu makulu gano tewali kutuukirira kwa nkomeredde ku nsi. Tewali kutuukirira kwa madaala, tewali kutakkiriza kweyongera obutayosa.

“(2.) Kale mu makulu ki mwe batuukiridde? Mwetegereze, kaakano tetwogera ku baana abawere mu Kristo, wabula ku Bakristaayo abakuze. Naye n’abaana abawere mu Kristo batuukiridde okutuuka n’okuba nga tebakola kibi. Kino Yokaana Omutukuvu akyogera mu lwatu; era tekiyinza kuwakanyizibwa olw’ebyokulabirako eby’Endagaano Enkadde. Kubanga, kiki, singa abo abaasinga obutukuvu mu Bayudaaya ab’edda oluusi baakolanga ekibi? Tetuyinza kuggya mu ekyo nti ‘Abakristaayo bonna bakola era bateekwa okukola ekibi ebbanga lyonna lye bamala nga balamu.’

“Naye Ebyawandiikibwa tebigamba nti, ‘Omuntu omutuukirivu ayonoona emirundi musanvu buli lunaku?’ Tebigamba bwe bityo. Ddala bigamba nti, ‘Omuntu omutuukirivu agwa emirundi omusanvu.’ Naye kino kintu kirala ddala; kubanga, Ekisooka, ebigambo, buli lunaku, tebiri mu kyawandiikibwa. Eky’okubiri, wano tewali kwogera ku kugwa mu kibi n’akatono. Ekyogerwako wano, kwe kugwa mu kubonaabona okw’ensi eno.

“Naye awalala Sulemaani agamba nti, ‘Tewali muntu atakola kibi.’ Awatali kubuusabuusa bwe kyali bwe kityo mu nnaku za Sulemaani; weewaawo, era okuva ku Sulemaani okutuuka ku Kristo mu kiseera ekyo tewaaliwo muntu atakola kibi. Naye embeera y’abo abaali wansi w’amateeka ne bw’eba yali etya, tuyinza okugamba awatali kutya, wamu ne Yokaana Omutukuvu, nti, okuva enjiri lwe yaweebwa, ‘oyo eyazaalibwa Katonda takola kibi.’

“Enkizo z’Abakristaayo tezirina kupimibwa n’akatono n’ebyo Endagaano Enkadde by’ewandiika ku abo abaali wansi w’enteekateeka y’Ekiyudaaya; kubanga kaakano ebiseera bituuse, Omwoyo Omutukuvu kaakano aweereddwa, obulokozi obukulu obwa Katonda kaakano buleeteddwa eri abantu olw’okubikkulirwa kwa Yesu Kristo. Obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu kaakano buteekeddwawo ku nsi, Omwoyo wa Katonda bwe yayogerako mu biseera eby’edda, (Dawudi tali wala nnyo okuba ekyokulabirako oba omutindo gw’okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo,) ’Abo abasembayo obunafu ku lunaku olwo babeere nga Dawudi, era ennyumba ya Dawudi ebeere ng’ennyumba ya Katonda, nga malayika wa Mukama abakulembeddemu.’ (Zekkaliya 12:8.)

’‘Naye Abatume bennyini baakola ekibi; Peetero olw’obunnanfuusi, Pawulo olw’empaka ze ez’amaanyi ne Balunabba. Ka tugambe nti baakikola, onoowakana bw’oti: ‘Bwe kiba nti Abatume babiri baakola ekibi omulundi gumu, olwo Abakristaayo abalala bonna, mu mirembe gyonna, bakola era bateekwa okukola ekibi ebbanga lyonna lye bamala nga balamu ?’ Nedda, Katonda atuwonye okwogera bwe tutyo. Tewaali kiwaliriza kibi kye baatikkibwa; ekisa kya Katonda ddala kyali kibamala. Era kitumala naffe leero.

“Naye Yakobo Omutukuvu agamba nti, ‘Ffenna tusobya mu ngeri nnyingi.’ Kituufu; naye ani ayogerwako wano? Kale, abo ‘abayigiriza abangi’ Katonda be yali tatumye; si Omutume yennyini, wadde Omukristaayo yenna ow’amazima. Nti mu kigambo ffe, ekikozesebwa mu ngeri y’okwogera eya bulijjo mu biwandiiko ebirala byonna awamu n’ebyo ebyaluŋŋamizibwa, Omutume teyandisobodde n’akatono kwegattamu yekka, wadde omukkiriza omulala yenna ow’amazima, kirabika, Ekisooka, okuva mu lunyiriri olw’omwenda, ‘Olulimi tulukozesa okutendereza Katonda, ate era lwe tukolimiza abantu.’ Mazima si ffe Abatume! si ffe abakkiriza! Eky’okubiri, okuva mu bigambo ebikulembera ekyawandiikibwa: ‘Abooluganda, abayigiriza tebasaanye kubeera bangi mu mmwe,’ ‘kubanga mukimanyi nga ffe tulisalirwa omusango munene okusinga abalala. Kubanga ffenna tusobya mu ngeri nnyingi.’ Ffe! Baani? Si Abatume wadde abakkiriza ab’amazima, wabula abo abaali ‘bagenda kusalirwa omusango munene,’ olw’ebisobyo ebyo ebingi. Weewaawo, Eky’okusatu, olunyiriri lwennyini lukakasa nti, ‘ffenna tusobya,’ tekiyinza kwogerwa ku bantu bonna wadde ku Bakristaayo bonna. Kubanga mu lwo amangu ddala wajjawo okwogera ku muntu ‘atasobya,’ nga ffe abaasooka okwogerwako bwe baasobyanga; n’olwekyo ayawulibwa ku bo mu lwatu, era n’ayitibwa ‘omuntu eyatuukirira.’

“Naye Yokaana Omutukuvu yennyini agamba nti, ‘Bwe twogera nti tetulina kibi, twerimba ffekka;’ era, ‘Bwe twogera nti tetwonoonanga, tumufuula mulimba, n’ekigambo kye tekiba mu ffe.’

“Nziramu nti, (1.) Olunyiriri olw’ekkumi lunyweza amakulu g’olw’omunaana: ‘Bwe twogera nti tetulina kibi,’ mu lusooka, kinnyonnyolwa ‘Bwe twogera nti tetwonoonanga,’ mu lunyiriri oluddako. (2.) Ensonga gye tutunuulira si eri nti twali twonoonye oba tetwonoonanga emabega; era tewali lunyiriri ku zino olugamba nti twonoona, oba nti tukola ekibi kaakano. (3.) Olunyiriri olw’omwenda lunnyonnyola olw’omunaana n’olw’ekkumi: ‘Naye bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okutusonyiwa ebibi byaffe, n’okutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna.’ Nga gy’obeera agambye nti, ‘Nsoose okukakasa nti, Omusaayi gwa Kristo gunaazaako buli kibi.’ So tewali muntu ayinza kugamba nti, ‘Sigwetaaga; sirina kibi kya kunaazibwako.’ ‘Bwe twogera nti tetulina kibi, nti ‘tetwonoonanga, twerimba ffekka,’ era tufuula Katonda mulimba: Naye ‘bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu,’ si ‘okutusonyiwa ebibi byaffe’ kyokka, wabula n’‘okutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna,’ tulyoke ‘tugende tuleme kwonoona nate.’ N’olwekyo, nga tukwatagana n’enjigiriza ya Yokaana Omutukuvu, era n’amakulu gonna ag’Endagaano Empya, tunyweza ekisalibwawo kino: Omukristaayo atuukiridde okutuuka n’okuba nti takola kibi.

“Eno y’enkizo ey’ekitiibwa eya buli Mukristaayo, weewaawo, ne bw’aba nga mwana muwere bubeezi mu Kristo. Naye ku Bakristaayo abakuze bokka kwe kuyinza okwogerwa nti batuukiridde mu makulu nga gano, nti, Eky’okubiri, bawonyezebwa ebirowoozo ebibi n’empisa embi. Ekisooka, okuva mu birowoozo ebibi oba eby’ekibi. Ddala, byandivudde wa? ‘Mu mutima gw’omuntu,’ bwe biba nga biriwo, ‘mwe muva ebirowoozo ebibi.’ N’olwekyo, omutima bwe guba nga tegukyali mubi, olwo ebirowoozo ebibi tebikyava mu gwo: Kubanga ‘omuti omulungi tegusobola kubala bibala bibi.’

“Era nga bwe bawonyezebwa ebirowoozo ebibi, bwe batyo ne mu mpisa embi. Buli omu ku bano ayinza okugamba, wamu ne Pawulo Omutukuvu, nti, ‘Nnakomererwa wamu ne Kristo; naye ndi mulamu; si nze nate, wabula Kristo ye mulamu mu nze;’—ebigambo ebinnyonnyola mu lwatu okununulibwa mu kibi eky’omunda awamu n’eky’okungulu. Kino kyogerwa mu ngeri ey’okugaana, ‘Siri mulamu,’ obutonde bwange obubi, omubiri gw’ekibi, buzikiriziddwa; era mu ngeri ey’okukakasa, ‘Kristo ye mulamu mu nze,’ era n’olwekyo byonna ebitukuvu, n’ebituukirivu, n’ebirungi. Ddala, byombi bino, ‘Kristo ye mulamu mu nze,’ ne, ‘Siri mulamu,’ bigattiddwa awatali kwawukana. Kubanga omusana gussa kimu gutya n’ekizikiza, oba Kristo ne Beriyali?

“N’olwekyo, Oyo abeera mu Bakristaayo bano ‘yalongoosa emitima gyabwe olw’okukkiriza;’ n’okutuuka n’okuba nti buli alina Kristo mu ye, ’essuubi ery’ekitiibwa, yeerongoosa nga ye bw’ali omulongoofu.’ Alongooseddwa okuva mu malala; kubanga Kristo yali muwombeefu mu mutima: Mulongoofu okuva mu kwegomba ne mu kwekkiririzaamu yekka; kubanga Kristo yayagalanga kukola kyokka Kitaawe ky’ayagala: Era mulongoofu okuva mu busungu, mu makulu ag’ekigambo aga bulijjo; kubanga Kristo ’yali muteefu era mukkakkamu. Ŋŋamba nti, mu makulu ag’ekigambo aga bulijjo; kubanga asunguwalira ekibi, ng’ate anakuwalira omwonoonyi. Awulira obutasiima ku buli kisobyo ekikolwa Katonda, naye omusobya amulaga kusaasira kwokka okw’ekisa.

“Bw’atyo Yesu bw’alokola abantu be mu bibi byabwe, si mu bibi eby’okungulu byokka, wabula mu bibi eby’emitima gyabwe. ‘Kituufu,’ abamu bagamba, ‘naye si okutuusa okufa, si mu nsi muno.’ Nedda, Yokaana Omutukuvu agamba nti, ‘Mu kino okwagala kwaffe mwe kutuukirizibwa, tulyoke tubeere n’obuvumu ku lunaku olw’okusalirako omusango; kubanga nga ye bw’ali, naffe bwe tuli mu nsi muno.’ Omutume wano, awatali kuwakanyizibwa kwonna, ayogera ku ye kennyini ne ku Bakristaayo abalala abalamu, b’agamba mu lwatu nti, si mu kufa kwokka oba oluvannyuma lw’okufa, wabula ’ mu nsi muno,’ bali ‘nga Mukama waabwe.’

“Ebigambo bye mu ssuula esooka bikwatagana ddala n’ekyo: ‘Katonda gwe musana, era mu ye temuli kizikiza n’akatono. Bwe tutambulira mu musana nga ye bw’ali omusana, tussa kimu ffekka na ffekka, n’omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo Omwana we gutunaazaako buli kibi.’ Era nate: ’Naye bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okutusonyiwa ebibi byaffe, n’okutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna.’ Kale, kyeyoleka nti, Omutume wano ayogera ku kununulibwa okukolebwa mu nsi muno: Kubanga tagamba nti, Omusaayi gwa Kristo gulitunaazaako, (mu ssaawa ey’okufa, oba ku lunaku olw’okusalirako omusango,) wabula ‘gutunaazaako,’ mu kiseera kino, ffe Abakristaayo abalamu ‘buli kibi.’ Era kyeyoleka mu ngeri y’emu nti, bwe wabaawo ekibi kyonna ekisigaddewo, tetunaaziddwako ‘buli’ kibi. Bwe wabaawo obutali butuukirivu bwonna obusigadde mu mmeeme, tenaaziddwako ‘obutali butuukirivu, bwonna. So tewabaawo agamba nti kino kikwata ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu kwokka, oba ku kutunaazaako omusango gw’ekibi: Ekisooka, kubanga kino kwe kutabula ekyo Omutume ky’ayawula mu lwatu, asooka okwogera, ’okutusonyiwa ebibi byaffe, n’oluvannyuma ‘okutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna.’ Eky’okubiri, kubanga kino kwe kugamba nti obutuukirivu tubuweebwa olw’ebikolwa, mu makulu agasingayo amaanyi; kwe kufuula obutukuvu bwonna obw’omunda, awamu n’obw’okungulu bwonna, ekiteekwa okusooka okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Kubanga okunaazibwa kuno okwogerwako bwe kuba nga si kulala wabula okutunaazaako omusango gw’ekibi, olwo tetunaaziddwako musango, kwe kugamba, tetuweereddwa butuukirivu, okuggyako nga tutambula ’mu musana, nga ye bw’ali mu musana.’ Kale kisigadde nti, Abakristaayo balokolebwa mu nsi muno mu buli kibi, mu butali butuukirivu bwonna; nti kaakano batuukiridde mu makulu nga gano, nti tebakola kibi, era bawonyezebwa ebirowoozo ebibi n’empisa embi.”

Tekyandisobose, okwogera okw’engeri eno, okwawakanya butereevu endowooza eyagalibwa ennyo abangi, abaali batwalibwa abalala, era oboolyawo nga nabo bennyini beetwala, okubeera ku Bakristaayo abasinga obulungi, (so nga, bino bwe biba bwe biri, tebaali Bakristaayo n’akatono,) obutanyiiza bantu nnyo. N’olwekyo, ennyiriri nnyingi ez’okuddamu oba ez’okunenya zaali zisuubirwa; naye ne nnemererwa mu ngeri ennungi. Simanyi nti waliwo n’emu eyalabika; bwe ntyo ne neeyongera mu kkubo lyange mu mirembe.

13. Oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera kitono, ndowooza mu biseera by’omusana, 1741, ne tufulumya ekitabo eky’okubiri eky’Ennyimba. Olw’okuba enjigiriza yali ekyategeerwa bubi nnyo, era n’olwekyo ng’eyogerwako bubi, ne ndaba nga kyetaagisa okwongera okunnyonnyola ku nsonga eno; ekyakolebwa mu nnyanjula yaakyo bwe kiti :—

“Ekirabo kino ekikulu ekya Katonda, obulokozi bw’emmeeme zaffe, si kirala wabula ekifaananyi kya Katonda ekiggya ekyolebwa ku mitima gyaffe. Kwe ‘kufuulibwa abaggya kw’abakkiriza mu mwoyo gw’ebirowoozo byabwe, nga bafaanana Oyo eyabatonda.’ Katonda kaakano ateeka ‘embazzi ku kikolo ky’omuti, ng’alongoosa emitima gyabwe olw’okukkiriza,’ era ‘ng’alongoosa ebirowoozo byonna eby’emitima gyabwe olw’okuluŋŋamya kw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu.’ Bwe balina essuubi lino, nti baliraba Katonda nga bw’ali, ‘beerongoosa nga ye bw’ali omulongoofu,’ era ‘batukuvu, nga oyo eyabayita bw’ali omutukuvu, mu mpisa zonna.’ Si nti bamaze okufuna byonna bye balifuna, oba nti bamaze okutuukirira mu makulu gano. Naye buli lunaku ‘beeyongera okuva mu maanyi okudda mu maanyi; nga balaba’ kaakano, ‘ng’abatunula mu ndabirwamu, ekitiibwa kya Mukama, bakyusibwa okufaanana ekifaananyi ekyo kye kimu, okuva mu kitiibwa okudda mu kitiibwa, olw’Omwoyo wa Mukama.’

“Era ‘Omwoyo wa Mukama w’ali, wabaawo eddembe;’ eddembe nga lino ’okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa,’ abaana b’ensi eno lye batagenda kukkiriza, newakubadde ng’omuntu alibabuulira. ‘Omwana yabafuula ab’eddembe’ abo ‘abazaalibwa Katonda’ bwe batyo, okuva mu kikolo ekyo ekinene eky’ekibi n’obukaawu, amalala. Bawulira nti ‘obusobozi bwabwe bwonna buva eri Katonda,’ nti Ye yekka ‘ali mu birowoozo byabwe byonna,’ era ’ akola mu bo okwagala n’okukola ky’asiima.’ Bawulira nti ’si bo’ ‘aboogera, wabula Omwoyo wa’ ‘Kitaabwe ayogera’ mu bo, era nti kyonna ekikolebwa n’emikono gyabwe, ’ Kitaabwe ali mu bo, y’akola emirimu.’ Bwe kityo Katonda gye bali y’abeera byonna mu byonna, nabo tebali kintu mu maaso ge. Bawonyezebwa okwekkiririzaamu kwabwe bokka, kubanga tebaagala kintu kyonna okuggyako Katonda by’ayagala ebitukuvu era ebituukiridde; si kuweebwa bye beetaaga nga babulwa, si kuwummula mu bulumi, [Kino kya maanyi nnyo. Mukama waffe yennyini yayagala okuwummula mu bulumi.’ Yakusaba’, naye nga yeewaddeyo: “Si nga nze bwe njagala,” bwe njegomba, “wabula nga ggwe bw’oyagala.”] wadde obulamu, oba okufa, oba ekitonde kyonna; wabula nga bakaaba obutayosa mu munda ddala mu mmeeme yaabwe nti, ‘Kitaffe, by’oyagala bikolebwe.’ Bawonyezebwa ebirowoozo ebibi, n’okuba nti tebiyinza kubayingiramu, nedda, wadde akaseera katono. Edda, ekirowoozo ekibi bwe kyayingiranga, baatunulanga waggulu, ne kibula. Naye kaakano tekiyingira, kubanga tewali kifo kyakyo, mu mmeeme ejjudde Katonda. Bawonye okubungeeta kw’ebirowoozo mu kusaba. Buli lwe bayiwa emitima gyabwe mu maaso ga Katonda mu ngeri esingako obutereevu, tebalowooza ku kintu kyonna ekyayita, [Kino kya maanyi nnyo okusukka. Laba obubaka “Ku Birowoozo Ebibungeeta.”] oba ekitaliiwo, oba ekigenda okujja, wabula ku Katonda yekka. Mu biseera ebyayita, baabanga n’ebirowoozo ebibungeeta ebyabafubutukangamu, ebyadduka ng’omukka; naye kaakano omukka ogwo tegunyooka n’akatono. Tebalina kutya wadde okubuusabuusa, oba ku mbeera yaabwe okutwaliza awamu, oba ku kikolwa kyonna ekimu. [Emirundi mingi bwe kiba bwe kityo; naye okumala ekiseera kyokka.] ‘Okufukibwako amafuta okuva eri Omutukuvu’ kubayigiriza buli ssaawa kye bagenda okukola, ne kye bagenda okwogera; [Okumala ekiseera kiyinza okuba bwe kityo; naye si bulijjo.] era n’olwekyo tebalina bwetaavu kukubaganya birowoozo ku kyo. [Oluusi tebalina bwetaavu; ebiseera ebirala babulina.] Mu makulu agamu bawonyezebwa okukemebwa; kubanga newakubadde ng’okukemebwa okutabalika kubeetooloola, naye tekubateganya. [Oluusi tekubateganya; ebiseera ebirala kubateganya, era nnyo ddala.] Buli kiseera emmeeme zaabwe ziba nkkakkamu era nteefu, emitima gyabwe minywevu era tegisagaasagana. Emirembe gyabwe, egikulukuta ng’omugga, ‘egisingira ddala okutegeera kwonna,’ era ‘basanyuka n’essanyu eritayogerekeka era erijjudde ekitiibwa.’ Kubanga ’baateekebwako akabonero k’Omwoyo okutuusa ku lunaku olw’okununulibwa,’ nga balina obujulirwa mu bo bennyini, nti ‘waliwo ekibaterekeddwa’ ‘engule ey’obutuukirivu Mukama gy’aliwa’ bo ‘ku lunaku luli.’ [Si bonna abalokoleddwa mu kibi; bangi ku bo tebannagifuna.]

“Si nti buli muntu mwana wa Setaani, okutuusa lw’afuulibwa omuggya bw’atyo mu kwagala: Wabula, buli alina okwesiga Katonda okunywevu, nti olw’obulungi bwa Kristo, ebibi bye bisonyiyiddwa,’ oyo mwana wa Katonda, era, bw’abeera mu ye, musika wa bisuubizo byonna. So tekimugwanira n’akatono okusuula obwesige bwe, oba okwegaana okukkiriza kw’afunye, kubanga kunafu, oba kubanga kugezesebwa omuliro,’ n’okutuuka n’emmeeme ye okubeera ‘mu nnaku olw’okukemebwa okw’engeri nnyingi.’

“So tetwaŋŋanga kugamba, ng’abamu bwe baakola, nti obulokozi buno bwonna buweebwa omulundi gumu. Ddala waliwo omulimu gwa Katonda mu baana be ogukolebwa mangu, awamu n’ogukolebwa mpolampola; era tewabulawo, tukimanyi, ekibiina ekinene eky’abajulirwa, abaafuna, mu kaseera kamu, oba okutegeera okw’olwatu okw’okusonyiyibwa ebibi byabwe, oba obujulirwa obw’olubeerera obw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Naye tetumanyi kyakulabirako na kimu, mu kifo kyonna, eky’omuntu eyafuna, mu kaseera kamu ddala, okusonyiyibwa ebibi, obujulirwa obw’olubeerera obw’Omwoyo, n’omutima omuggya, omulongoofu.

“Ddala, engeri Katonda gy’ayinza okukolamu, tetuyinza kugimanya; naye engeri eya bulijjo gy’akolamu y’eno: Abo abeesiganga edda nti batuukirivu, nti bagagga, era nti beeyongedde ebintu, era nga tebaliiko kye beetaaga, Omwoyo wa Katonda ng’abakozesaako ekigambo kye, bakakasibwa nti baavu era bali bwereere. Byonna bye baakola bijjukizibwa gye bali era ne bisengekebwa mu maaso gaabwe, n’okulaba ne balaba obusungu bwa Katonda nga bubawanikiddwa ku mitwe, era ne bawulira nti basaanidde okusalirwa omusango gwa ggeyeena. Mu nnaku yaabwe bakaabirira Mukama, n’abalaga nti abaggyeeko ebibi byabwe, era n’abaggulirawo obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu mu mitima gyabwe, obutuukirivu, n’emirembe, n’essanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.’ Ennaku n’obulumi bidduse, n’ekibi tekikyabafuga’ nate. Nga bamanyi nti baweereddwa obutuukirivu bwereere olw’okukkiriza omusaayi gwe, balina emirembe ne Katonda ‘ku bwa Yesu Kristo;’ ‘basanyuka mu ssuubi ery’ekitiibwa kya Katonda,’ era ‘okwagala kwa Katonda kufukiddwa mu mitima gyabwe.’

“Mu mirembe gino basigala ennaku, oba wiiki, oba emyezi, era emirundi mingi balowooza nti tebakyaddamu kulaba lutalo; okutuusa abamu ku balabe baabwe ab’edda, ebibi byabwe eby’omu kifuba, oba ekibi ekyabeesibangako amangu, (oboolyawo obusungu oba okwegomba,) lwe bibalumba nate, ne bibasindika n’amaanyi, balyoke bagwe. Olwo okutya ne kugolokoka, nti tebagenda kugumiikiriza okutuusa ku nkomerero; era emirundi mingi okubuusabuusa, oba Katonda tabeerabidde, oba tebeerimba bokka mu kulowooza nti ebibi byabwe byasonyiyibwa. Wansi w’ebire bino, naddala bwe bakubaganya ebirowoozo ne Setaani, batambula nga bakungubaga olunaku lwonna. Naye tekitera kumala bbanga ddene Mukama waabwe nga tannaba kwennyonnyolako yekka, ng’abaweereza Omwoyo Omutukuvu okubabudaabuda, okutegeeza obutayosa n’emyoyo gyabwe nti’ baana ba Katonda. Olwo ddala ne baba bateefu era bakkakkamu era abayigirizika, ng’omwana omuto. Era kaakano ne balyoka basooka okulaba entobo y’omutima gwabwe; [Tekyewuunyisa, nti ng’ekitabo kino kikyaliwo, ekyafulumizibwa emyaka amakumi abiri mu ena egiyise, omuntu yenna okunnyimirira mu maaso n’agamba nti eno njigiriza mpya, era nti si gye nnali njigirizza emabega?—[Ekiwandiiko kino kyasooka okufulumizibwa mu mwaka 1765 EDIT.]] Katonda gye yali tayagala kubabikkulira emabega, emmeeme ereme kuzirika mu maaso ge, n’omwoyo gwe yatonda. Kaakano balaba eby’omuzizo byonna ebyakwekebwa omwo, obuziba bw’amalala, n’okwekkiririzaamu, ne ggeyeena; naye nga balekawo obujulirwa mu bo bennyini, ‘Oli musika wa Katonda, musika awamu ne Kristo, ne wakati mu kugezesebwa kuno okw’omuliro;’ ekyongera obutayosa okutegeera kwabwe okw’amaanyi kwe baba nakwo mu kiseera ekyo nti tebasobola kweyamba, n’enjala etayogerekeka gye bawulira ey’okufuulibwa abaggya mu bujjuvu mu kifaananyi kye, mu ‘butuukirivu n’obutukuvu obw’amazima.’ Olwo Katonda n’ajjukira okwegomba kw’abo abamutya, n’abawa eriiso eddamu, n’omutima omulongoofu; abassaako ekifaananyi kye n’erinnya lye; Abatonda buggya mu Kristo Yesu; ajja gye bali n’Omwana we n’Omwoyo we ow’omukisa, era, ng’asenga mu mmeeme zaabwe, n’abayingiza mu ‘kiwummulo ekisigaddeyo eri abantu ba Katonda.’”

Wano sirina kye nnyinza okuggyako okulaga, (1.) Nti kino kye kinnyonnyola ekisingayo amaanyi kye twali tuwadde ku kutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo; ddala eky’amaanyi ennyo mu nsonga ezisukka mu emu, nga bwe kiragiddwa mu biwandiiko ebigattiddwako. (2.) Nti tewali kye twongeddeko oluvannyuma ku nsonga eno, oba mu nnyimba oba mu bigambo ebya bulijjo, ekitali mu nnyanjula eno butereevu oba mu ngeri etali ya butereevu. Bwe kityo, enjigiriza yaffe eya kaakano ne bw’eba entuufu oba enkyamu, naye y’emu gye twayigiriza okuva ku lubereberye.

14. Sseetaaga kwongera bukakafu ku kino, nga njuliza ebitundu bingi okuva mu kitabo ekyo kyennyini. Kiyinza okumala, okujuliza ekitundu ky’oluyimba lumu lwokka olusembayo mu kitabo ekyo:—

Mukama, nzikiriza nti waliwo ekiwummulo,

Abantu bo bonna kye bamanyi;

Ekiwummulo ng’essanyu eddongoofu lye lifuga,

Era nga ggwe wekka gw’oyagalibwa;

Ekiwummulo ng’okwegomba kwonna okw’emmeeme yaffe

Kunywezeddwa ku bintu eby’omu ggulu;

Okubuusabuusa n’obulumi n’okutya we bikoma,

Nga bigobeddwa okwagala okutuukiridde.

Nga tuwonyezeddwa buli kunyeenya okubi,

(Omwana atufudde ab’eddembe,)

Amaanyi gonna aga ggeyeena tugalinnyako,

Mu ddembe ery’ekitiibwa.

Nga tuli bulungi mu kkubo ery’obulamu, waggulu

W’okufa, n’ensi, ne ggeyeena tulinnya

Tuzuula, bwe tutuukirizibwa mu kwagala,

Olusuku lwaffe lwe twanoonya ebbanga ddene.

Ayi, singa kaakano nnyinza okumanya ekiwummulo,

Okukkiriza, n’okuyingira!

Kaakano, Omulokozi, kaakano mpa amaanyi,

Ondeke nkome okwonoona!

Ggyawo obukakanyavu buno mu mutima gwange,

Obutakkiriza buno buggyewo:

Mpa ekiwummulo eky’okukkiriza,

Ssabbiiti ey’okwagala kwo.

Jjangu, Ayi Omulokozi wange, jjangu

Okke mu mmeeme yange!

Tolwa nate okuva ku kitonde kyo,

Omutandisi wange era enkomerero yange.

Essanyu lye wanteekerateekera,

Lireme kulwisibwa nate:

Jjangu, empeera yange ennene ennyo,

Gwe nnasooka okutondebwa olw’okubeera naawe.

Jjangu, Kitaffe, Omwana, n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu,

Onfuule ekifo kyo eky’okubeeramu!

Byonna bye ndi bibulire mu ggwe:

Byonna bibulire mu Katonda!

Waliwo ekiyinza okusinga kino okweyoleka, nti, (1.) Nti wano nawo waliwo obulokozi obujjuvu era obuwanvu nga bwe twali twogeddeko bwonna? (2.) Nti kino kyogerwako ng’ekiyinza okufunibwa olw’okukkiriza kwokka, era nga kiziyizibwa butakkiriza bwokka? (3.) Nti okukkiriza kuno, era n’olwekyo obulokozi bwe kuleeta, kwogerwako ng’okuweebwa mu kaseera kamu? (4.) Nti kirowoozebwa nti akaseera ako kayinza okuba kaakano? nti tetwetaaga kulinda kaseera kalala? nti “kaakano,” ddala “kaakano, kye kiseera ekisiimibwa? kaakano lwe lunaku lw’” obulokozi buno obujjuvu“?” Era, Ekisembayo, nti, omuntu yenna bw’ayogera mu ngeri endala, ye muntu aleeta enjigiriza empya mu ffe?

fields.title: Ebitundu 15-21
fields.body_html:
15. Nga wayiseewo omwaka nga gumu, kwe kugamba, mu mwaka 1742, ne tufulumya ekitabo ekirala eky’Ennyimba. Olw’okuba empaka kaakano zaali zituuse ku ntikko, twayogera ku nsonga eno mu bujjuvu okusinga bwe twali tukoze emabega. N’olwekyo ennyimba nnyingi nnyo mu kitabo kino zoogera butereevu ku nsonga eno. Era n’ennyanjula bw’etyo, era, olw’okuba nnyimpi, kiyinza obutaba kibi okugiteekamu yonna :—

“(1.) Oboolyawo okukyawa okw’awamu okw’okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo kuyinza okuva okusinga ku butategeera bulungi mbeera yaakwo. Tukkiriza n’omutima gumu, era tulangirira obutayosa, nti tewali kutuukirira ng’okwo mu bulamu buno, okutegeeza oba okusonyiyibwa obutakola birungi, n’obutagenda mu biragiro byonna ebya Katonda, oba okuwonyezebwa obutamanya, ensobi, okukemebwa, n’obunafu lukumi obukwatagana n’omubiri n’omusaayi.

“(2.) Ekisooka. Tetukoma ku kukkiriza kyokka, naye tuwakanya n’amaanyi, nti tewali kutuukirira mu bulamu buno, okutegeeza okusonyiyibwa kwonna okw’obutagenda mu biragiro byonna ebya Katonda, oba obutakolera bantu bonna birungi nga tukyalina ekiseera, newakubadde ‘naddala ab’omu nnyumba y’okukkiriza.’ Tukkiriza nti, si baana bawere bokka mu Kristo, abaakafuna okununulibwa mu musaayi gwe, wabula n’abo ‘abakuze okutuuka ku bantu abatuukiridde,’ bateekwa ddala, buli lwe bafuna akakisa, ’okulya omugaati n’okunywa envinnyo nga bajjukira Ye,’ era ‘n’okunoonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa;’ olw’okusiiba, awamu n’okwefuga, ‘okukangavvula emibiri gyabwe, n’okugifuga;’ era, okusinga byonna, okuyiwa emmeeme zaabwe mu kusaba, mu kyama, ne mu lukuŋŋaana olunene.

“(3.) Eky’okubiri tukkiriza nti, tewali kutuukirira ng’okwo mu bulamu buno, okutegeeza okununulibwa okujjuvu, oba okuva mu butamanya, oba mu nsobi, mu bintu ebitali bikulu eri obulokozi, oba mu kukemebwa okw’engeri nnyingi, oba mu bunafu obutabalika, omubiri oguvunda bwe gunyigiriza emmeeme, oba kitono oba kingi. Tetuyinza kuzuula nsonga yonna mu Byawandiikibwa okulowooza nti, omuntu yenna abeera mu nnyumba ey’ebbumba awonyezeddwa ddala oba obunafu bw’omubiri, oba obutamanya bintu bingi; oba okulowooza nti waliwo atayinza kukola nsobi, oba okugwa mu kukemebwa okw’engeri ez’enjawulo.

“(4.) Naye kale, otegeeza ani bw’oyogera ku ‘oyo atuukiridde?’ Tutegeeza oyo alimu ‘endowooza eyali mu Kristo,’ era ‘atambula nga Kristo bwe yatambula;’ omuntu ‘alina emikono emirongoofu n’omutima omulongoofu,’ oba ‘eyanaazibwako buli kintu ekyonoona omubiri n’omwoyo;’ oyo mu ye ‘temuli kyesittaza,’ era, n’olwekyo, ‘takola kibi.’ Okukinnyonnyola katono mu bujjuvu: Tutegeera mu kigambo ekyo eky’Ebyawandiikibwa, ‘omuntu atuukiridde,’ oyo Katonda gw’atuukirizzaamu ekigambo kye ekyesigwa, ‘Mu butali bulongoofu bwammwe bwonna ne mu bakatonda bammwe abalala bonna ndibalongoosa: Era ndibalokola mu butali bulongoofu bwammwe bwonna.’ Tutegeera mu kino, oyo Katonda ‘gwe yatukuliza ddala mu mubiri, mu mmeeme, ne mu mwoyo;’ oyo ‘atambulira mu musana nga Ye bw’ali mu musana, mu ye temuli kizikiza n’akatono; omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo Omwana we nga gumunaazizzaako buli kibi.’

“(5.) Omuntu ono kaakano ayinza okutegeeza abantu bonna nti, ‘Nnakomererwa wamu ne Kristo: Naye ndi mulamu; si nze nate, wabula Kristo ye mulamu mu nze.’ ‘Mutukuvu nga Katonda eyamuyita bw’ali omutukuvu,’ mu mutima ne ‘mu mpisa zonna.’ ‘Ayagala Mukama Katonda we n’omutima gwe gwonna,’ era amuweereza ‘n’amaanyi ge gonna.’ ‘Ayagala muliraanwa we,’ buli muntu, ‘nga bwe yeeyagala yekka;’ weewaawo, ‘nga Kristo bw’atwagala;’ naddala abo ‘abamukozesa obubi ne bamuyigganya, kubanga tebamanyi Mwana, wadde Kitaffe.’ Ddala emmeeme ye yonna kwagala, ejjudde ‘omwoyo ogusaasira, n’ekisa, n’obuwombeefu, n’obuteefu, n’obugumiikiriza.’ Era obulamu bwe bukwatagana nakyo, nga bujjudde ‘omulimu gw’okukkiriza, okugumiikiriza kw’essuubi, n’okufuba kw’okwagala.’ ‘Na buli’ ky’‘akola mu kigambo oba mu kikolwa,’ ‘byonna abikola mu linnya,’ mu kwagala ne mu maanyi, ‘lya Mukama waffe Yesu.’ Mu bigambo ebitono, akola ‘Katonda by’ayagala ku nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu.’

“(6.) Kuno kwe kubeera omuntu atuukiridde, okubeera ‘atukuziddwa ddala;’ weewaawo ‘okubeera n’omutima ogwaka gwonna n’okwagala kwa Katonda,’ (nga nkozesa ebigambo bya Ssaabalabirizi Usher,) ‘n’okuwaayo obutayosa buli kirowoozo, n’ekigambo, n’omulimu, nga ssaddaaka ey’omwoyo, esiimibwa Katonda ku bwa Kristo.’ Mu buli kirowoozo eky’emitima gyaffe, mu buli kigambo eky’ennimi zaffe, mu buli mulimu ogw’emikono gyaffe, ‘okulangirira ettendo ly’oyo eyatuyita okuva mu kizikiza okuyingira mu musana gwe ogw’ekitalo.’ Ayi, singa ffe, era ne bonna abanoonya Mukama Yesu mu mazima, tuba bwe tutyo ‘abatuukirizibwa okufuuka omu!’”

Eno ye njigiriza gye twabuulira okuva ku lubereberye, era gye tubuulira leero. Ddala, bwe twagitunuulira mu buli ngeri, ne tugigeraageranya emirundi n’emirundi n’ekigambo kya Katonda ku ludda olumu, n’ebyo abaana ba Katonda bye bayiseemu ku ludda olulala, ne tulaba wala okusingawo mu mbeera n’engeri z’okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo. Naye era tewali kukontana n’akatono wakati w’endowooza zaffe ezaasooka n’ezaasembayo. Okutegeera kwaffe okwasooka kwali nti, Kwe kubeera n’“endowooza eyali mu Kristo,” n’okutambula “nga Ye bwe yatambula;” okubeera n’endowooza yonna eyali mu Ye, n’okutambula bulijjo nga ye bwe yatambula: Mu bigambo ebirala, okwewaayo eri Katonda munda ne kungulu; okwewaayo ddala mu mutima ne mu bulamu. Era kaakano tukutegeera mu ngeri y’emu, awatali kwongerako wadde okukendeezaako.

16. Ennyimba ezikwata ku kyo mu kitabo kino nnyingi nnyo okuzikoppa zonna. Nja kujuliza bujuliza ebitundu by’essatu :—

Omulokozi ow’okuggya mu kibi, nnindirira okukakasa

Nti Yesu lye linnya lyo eriwonya;

Okufiirwa, bwe ntuukirizibwa mu kwagala,

Kyonna kye nnina, oba kye nnyinza, oba kye ndi;

Nneesigama ku kigambo kyo ekyesigwa,

“Omuddu alibeera nga Mukama we.”

Tuukiriza mu nze ekigendererwa ekyo eky’ekisa

Obulamu bwo obw’omuwendo kye bwaweebwayo;

Nnunula mu bujeemu bwonna,

Nzizaawo, ompeesa okusaanira eggulu.

Bw’otonnaazeeko buli bbala lyange,

Okubonaabona kwo n’okukkiriza kwange bya bwereere.

Tewafa, ndyoke mbeere mulamu,

Nga sikyali wange, wabula wuwo?

Ndyoke mpaayo omubiri, emmeeme, n’omwoyo

Eri Oyo eyeewaayo ku lwange?

Kale jjangu, Mukama wange era Katonda wange,

Twala ekyo eky’omuwendo kye wagula n’omusaayi gwo.

Weetwalire omuddu wo ow’enjawulo,

Ku lw’amazima go n’okusaasira kwo;

Tukuza mu nze erinnya lyo ery’ekitiibwa;

Ntwala nfuuke wuwo mu kaseera kano;

Era onkyuse ondongoose ddala;

Mbeere wuwo wekka mu bulamu ne mu kufa. (Olupapula 80.)

Nga nnalondebwa okuva mu nsi, bwe mba nga kaakano nnyimiridde,

Nga nnyonjezeddwa n’obutuukirivu obw’obwakatonda;

Bwe mba nga, nnaleetebwa mu nsi ensuubize,

Mpita Omulokozi owange mu butuufu;

Yiwa Omwoyo atukuza,

Ammalako ennyonta era annaaze ne mba mulongoofu,

Kaakano, Omulokozi, enkuba ey’ekisa

Ekke, enfuule omulongoofu okuva mu kibi.

Nnongoosa okuva mu buli bbala ly’ekibi:

Bakatonda bange abalala bonna basuulibwe eri:

Nnaaza okuva mu buli kirowoozo ekibi,

Okuva mu bucaafu bwonna obw’okwerowoozaako n’amalala.

Obukyayi obw’endowooza ey’omubiri

Buggye mu mubiri gwange omulundi gumu:

Mpa omutima omugonvu, ogwewaddeyo,

Era omulongoofu, era ogujjudde okukkiriza n’okwagala.

Ayi, singa kaakano, nga nsumuluddwa mu kibi,

Nnyinza okukakasa ekigambo kyo mu bujjuvu bwakyo bwonna,

Ne nnyingira mu kiwummulo kyo ekisuubize;

Kanani ey’okwagala kwo okutuukiridde!

Kaakano ka ntuuke ku ntikko y’okutuukirira!

Kaakano ka ngwe mu butaba kintu;

Mbe ekitono okusinga obutaba kintu mu maaso gange,

Era mpulire nti Kristo ye byonna mu byonna. (Olupapula 258.)

Mukama, nzikiriza, omulimu gwo ogw’ekisa

Gutuukiridde mu mmeeme;

Omutima gw’oyo alaba amaaso go mulongoofu,

Omwoyo gwe gufuuliddwa mulamu ddala.

Okuva mu buli bulwadde, olw’ekigambo kyo,

Okuva mu buli ndwadde embi,

Alokoleddwa, n’azzibwawo mu bulamu obutuukiridde,

Mu butukuvu obutuukiridde:

Atambula mu ddembe ery’ekitiibwa,

Ng’afiiridde ddala ekibi:

Amazima, Omwana, amufudde wa ddembe,

Era ddala wa ddembe.

Mu mmeeme ye yonna ekitiibwa kyo kyaka,

Emmeeme ye yonna efuuliddwa empya,

Era eyonjeddwa mu butuukirivu obw’obwakatonda,

Era eyambaziddwa era ejjuziddwa Katonda.

Kino kye kiwummulo, obulamu, emirembe,

Abantu bo bonna bye bakakasa;

Okwagala kwe kusiba okutuukiridde,

Era emmeeme yaabwe yonna kwagala.

Ayi eddoboozi ery’essanyu ery’ekisa ky’enjiri!

Kristo alirabikira mu nze;

Nze, weewaawo nze, ndiraba amaaso ge,

Ndibeera mutukuvu wano!

Kaakano akyalira ennyumba ey’ebbumba,

Anyeenya amaka ge ag’omu maaso;—

Ayi, Mukama, singa ku lunaku luno olw’essanyu,

Oyingira mu yeekaalu yo!

Jjangu, Ayi Katonda wange, weeyoleke,

Jjuza ekifo kino kyonna ekinene ekyereere;

Ggwe wekka gw’oyinza okujjuza omwoyo gwange:

Jjangu, Ayi Katonda wange, Katonda wange!

Tuukiriza, tuukiriza okwegomba kwange okunene,

Okunene ng’obutakoma!

Mpa, mpa byonna emmeeme yange by’eyetaaga,

Byonna, byonna ebiri mu ggwe ! (Olupapula 298.)

17. Ku Mmande, nga June 25, 1744, Olukuŋŋaana lwaffe Olusooka ne lutandika; nga waliwo Abasumba mukaaga n’Ababuulizi baffe bonna. Ku makya agaddako ne twekenneenya n’obwegendereza enjigiriza y’okutukuzibwa, oba okutuukirira. Ebibuuzo ebyabuuzibwa ku yo, n’amakulu g’okuddamu okwaweebwa, byali bwe biti:—

“EKIBUUZO. Kitegeeza ki okutukuzibwa?

“OKUDDAMU. Okufuulibwa omuggya mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, ‘mu butuukirivu ne mu butukuvu obw’amazima.’

“Ek. Kiki ekitegeezebwa mu kubeera Omukristaayo atuukiridde?

“Ok. Okwagala Katonda n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, n’amagezi, n’emmeeme. (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 6:5.)

“Ek. Kino kitegeeza nti ekibi kyonna eky’omunda kiggibwawo?

“Ok. Awatali kubuusabuusa; oba twandiyinzizza tutya Okugambibwa nti ‘twalokolebwa mu butali bulongoofu ‘bwaffe bwonna?’ (Ezeekyeri 36:29.)”

Olukuŋŋaana lwaffe Olwokubiri lwatandika nga August 1, 1745. Ku makya agaddako ne twogera ku kutukuzibwa bwe tuti :—

“Ek. Okutukuzibwa okw’omunda kutandika ddi?

“Ok. Mu kaseera omuntu w’aweerwa obutuukirivu. (Naye ekibi kisigala mu ye, weewaawo, ensigo y’ekibi kyonna, okutuusa lw’atukuzibwa ddala.) Okuva mu kiseera ekyo omukkiriza afiira ekibi mpolampola, era akula mu kisa.

“Ek. Kino kitera okuweebwa nga wabulayo akaseera katono okufa kutuuke?

“Ok. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, eri abo abatakisuubira mangu okusinga awo.

“Ek. Naye tuyinza okukisuubira mangu okusinga awo?

“Ok. Lwaki nedda? Kubanga, newakubadde nga tukkiriza, (1.) Nti abakkiriza abasinga obungi, be twali tumanyi okutuusa kaakano, tebaatukuzibwa bwe batyo okutuusa nga banaatera okufa; (2.) Nti batono ku abo Pawulo Omutukuvu Be yawandiikira Ebbaluwa ze abaali bwe batyo mu kiseera ekyo; wadde, (3.) Ye yennyini mu kiseera we yawandiikira Ebbaluwa ze ezaasooka; naye bino byonna tebikakasa, nti tetuyinza kuba bwe tutyo leero.

“Ek. Tusaanidde kubuulira tutya okutukuzibwa?

“Ok. Kumpi n’akatono eri abo abatafuba kweyongerayo: Eri abo abafuba, bulijjo mu ngeri ey’ekisuubizo; bulijjo nga tusikiriza, okusinga okuwaliriza.”

Olukuŋŋaana lwaffe Olwokusatu lwatandika ku Lwokubiri, nga May 13, 1746.

Mu lwo twasoma n’obwegendereza Ebiwandiiko by’Enkuŋŋaana ebbiri ezaasooka, okulaba oba nga waliwo ekiri omwo ekiyinza okusalibwako oba okukyusibwa nga tumaze okulowooza ennyo. Naye tetwalaba nsonga ya kukyusa mu ngeri yonna bye twali twakkaanyaako emabega.

Olukuŋŋaana lwaffe Olwokuna lwatandika ku Lwokubiri, nga June 16, 1747. Olw’okuba waaliwo abantu abawerako, abaali tebakkiriza njigiriza y’okutuukirira, ne tukkaanya okugyekenneenya okuva ku musingi.

Kino kiryoke kikolebwe, ne kibuuzibwa nti,

“Baganda baffe abatakkiriziganya naffe ku kutukuzibwa okujjuvu bakkiriza kyenkana wa?

“Ok. Bakkiriza, (1.) Nti buli muntu ateekwa okutukuzibwa ddala mu kaseera ak’okufa. (2.) Nti okutuusa olwo omukkiriza buli lunaku akula mu kisa, asembera okumpi n’okumpi ku kutuukirira. (3.) Nti tusaanidde okufuba obutayosa okukutuukako, n’okukubiriza abalala bonna okukola bwe batyo.

“Ek. Ffe tubakkiriza ki?

“Ok. Tukkiriza, (1.) Nti bangi ku abo abaafiira mu kukkiriza, weewaawo, abasinga obungi ku abo be twali tumanyi, tebaatuukirizibwa mu kwagala okutuusa nga wabulayo akaseera katono okufa kwabwe kutuuke. (2.) Nti ekigambo abatukuzibwa Pawulo Omutukuvu akikozesa obutayosa ku bonna abaaweebwa obutuukirivu. (3.) Nti mu kigambo kino kyokka, tatera, oba tategeezangako, ’abaalokolebwa mu kibi kyonna.’ (4.) Nti, n’olwekyo, tekisaana kukikozesa mu makulu ago, nga tetugasseeko kigambo ddala, mu bujjuvu, oba ekifaanana ng’ekyo. (5.) Nti abawandiisi abaaluŋŋamizibwa kumpi bulijjo boogera ku oba eri abo abaaweebwa obutuukirivu, naye emirundi mitono nnyo boogera ku oba eri abo abaatukuzibwa ddala. [Kwe kugamba, eri abo bokka, nga baawuddwa ku balala; naye boogera nabo, awamu n’abalala, kumpi bulijjo.] (6.) Nti, n’olwekyo, kitugwanira okwogera kumpi bulijjo ku mbeera y’okuweebwa obutuukirivu; naye emirundi mitono, [Emirundi mitono, nkkiriza; naye era mu bifo ebimu emirundi mingi nnyo, n’amaanyi, era mu lwatu.] ’waakiri mu bigambo ebijjuvu era eby’olwatu, ku kutukuzibwa okujjuvu.’

“Ek. Kale wa we twawukanira?

“Ok. Wano: Tusaanidde okusuubira okulokolebwa mu kibi kyonna nga tetunnatuuka mu kaseera ak’okufa?

“Ek. Waliwo ekisuubizo kyonna eky’olwatu mu Byawandiikibwa eky’ekyo,—nti Katonda alitulokola mu kibi kyonna?

“Ok. Kiriwo:’Mukama y’alinunula Isirayiri n’amuggya mu byonoono bye byonna.’ (Zabbuli 130:8.)

“Kino kyogerwa mu bujjuvu okusingawo mu bunnabbi bwa Ezeekyeri:’Ndibamaansirako amazzi amayonjo, era ndibaggyako obutali bulongoofu bwammwe bwonna n’okuva ku bakatonda abalala bonna, ne mbafuula abalongoofu. Ndibalokola mu butali bulongoofu bwammwe bwonna.’ (Ezeekyeri 36:25, 29.)

Tewali kisuubizo kiyinza kweyoleka okusinga kino. Era kino Omutume ky’ayogerako mu lwatu mu kubuulirira okwo: ‘Abaagalwa, nga bwe tulina ebisuubizo ng’ebyo, twetukuze mu buli kintu ekyonoona omubiri n’omwoyo, nga tutuukiriza obutukuvu mu kutya Katonda.’ (2 Abakkolinso 7:1.) Era ekisuubizo ekyo eky’edda kyeyolefu era kitegeerekeka mu ngeri y’emu: ’Mukama Katonda wo alikomola omutima gwo, n’omutima gwa bazzukulu bo, bw’otyo oyagalanga Mukama Katonda wo n’omutima gwo gwonna, n’emmeeme yo yonna.’ (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 30:6)

“Ek. Naye waliwo ekigambo kyonna ekikwatagana n’ekyo mu Ndagaano Empya?

“Ok. Kiriwo, era kyogeddwa mu bigambo ebisingayo okutegeerekeka. Bwe kiti 1 Yokaana 3:8: ‘Omwana wa Katonda kyeyava ajja mu nsi azikirize ebikolwa bya Setaani;’ ebikolwa bya Setaani, awatali kkomo lyonna wadde okukugira; naye ekibi kyonna mulimu gwa Setaani. Ekikwatagana nakyo kye kigambo kya Pawulo Omutukuvu: ’Kristo yayagala Ekkanisa ne yeewaayo ku lwayo, alyoke yeefunire Ekkanisa ey’ekitiibwa, eteriiko bbala wadde akamogo oba ekintu kyonna ekikyamu, wabula ebeere entukuvu, etuukiridde.’ (Abaefeso 5:25-27.)

“Era ekigambo kye mu ssuula ey’omunaana ey’Abaruumi, ennyiriri 3, 4, kitegeeza kye kimu: ‘Katonda yatuma Omwana we, eby’obutuukirivu mu mateeka biryoke bituukirire mu ffe, abatatambulira mu mubiri naye abatambulira mu mwoyo.’ [Abaruumi 8:3, 4]

“Ek. Endagaano Empya erina ensonga endala yonna ey’okusuubira okulokolebwa mu kibi kyonna?

“Ok. Awatali kubuusabuusa erina; mu kusaba okwo ne mu biragiro, ebyenkana ebigambo ebisingayo amaanyi.

“Ek. Kusaba ki kw’otegeeza?

“Ok. Okusaba olw’okutukuzibwa okujjuvu; okwandibadde, singa tewaliwo kintu ng’ekyo, kusekerera Katonda bwereere. Bwe kuti naddala, (1.) ‘Tulokole eri omubi.’ Kale, kino bwe kikolebwa, bwe tununulibwa mu bubi bwonna, tewayinza kubaawo kibi kisigaddewo. (2.) ‘Sisabira bano bokka naye nsabira n’abo abanzikiriza olw’ekigambo kyabwe, bonna babeere bumu, nga ggwe Kitange bw’oli mu Nze, nange nga ndi mu ggwe, nabo babeerenga mu ffe; Nze nga ndi mu bo, era naawe ng’oli mu Nze balyoke bafuukire ddala omuntu omu.’ (Yokaana 17:20-23.) (3.) ‘Nfukaamirira Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, abawe, mmwe, nga mulina emirandira era nga munywedde mu kwagala, okusobola okutegeera, awamu n’abatukuvu bonna, obugazi, n’obuwanvu, n’obuziba, n’obugulumivu, n’okumanya okwagala kwa Kristo okusukkiridde okutegeera kwonna; mulyoke mujjuzibwe okujjula kwonna okwa Katonda.’ (Abaefeso 3:14, &c) (4.) ‘Katonda ow’emirembe yennyini abatukulize ddala. Era nsaba Katonda, omwoyo gwammwe gwonna, n’emmeeme yammwe n’omubiri gwammwe, bikuumibwenga nga tebiriiko kya kunenyezebwa okutuusa ku kujja kwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.’ (1 Basessaloniika 5:23.)

“Ek. Kiragiro ki ekiriwo ekitegeeza kye kimu?

“Ok. (1.) ‘Kibagwanira okubeeranga abatuukirivu nga Kitammwe ali mu ggulu bw’ali Omutuukirivu.’ (Matayo 5:48.) (2.) ‘Yagalanga Mukama Katonda wo n’omutima gwo gwonna, n’obulamu bwo bwonna, n’amagezi go gonna.’ (Matayo 22:37.) Naye okwagala kwa Katonda bwe kujjuza omutima gwonna, tewayinza kubaamu kibi.

“Ek. Naye kirabika kitya nti kino kirina okukolebwa nga tetunnatuuka mu kaseera ak’okufa?

“Ok. (1.) Okuva mu mbeera yennyini ey’ekiragiro, ekitaweebwa bafu, wabula abalamu. N’olwekyo, ‘Yagalanga Katonda n’omutima gwo gwonna,’ tekiyinza kutegeeza nti, Onookola kino nga ofa; wabula, ng’okyali mulamu.

“(2.) Okuva mu byawandiikibwa eby’olwatu: (i.) ‘Kubanga ekisa kya Katonda ekireetera abantu bonna obulokozi kirabise, era kituyigiriza tuleke obutatya Katonda, n’okwegomba kw’ensi, tulyoke tube beegendereza, abatuukirivu abatya Katonda nga tuli mu mulembe gwa kaakano; nga tulindirira okulabika kw’ekitiibwa kya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, eyeewaayo ku lwaffe, alyoke atununule mu bujeemu bwaffe bwonna, era yeerongooseza eggwanga ery’envuma, erinyiikirira ebikolwa ebirungi.’ (Tito 2:11-14.) (ii.) ‘Yatuyimusiriza obuyinza obw’obulokozi, okulaga bajjajjaffe ekisa kye yasuubiza; ekirayiro kye yalayirira jjajjaffe Ibulayimu, okutuwa, ffe, nga tulokoleddwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe, okumuweereza awatali kutya, mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu mu maaso ge, ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.’ (Lukka 1:69, &c.)

“Ek. Waliwo ekyokulabirako kyonna mu Byawandiikibwa eky’abantu abaatuuka ku kino?

“Ok. Weewaawo; Yokaana Omutukuvu, ne bonna b’ayogerako nti, ‘Mu kino okwagala kwaffe mwe kutuukirizibwa, tulyoke tubeere n’obuvumu ku lunaku olw’okusalirako omusango; kubanga nga ye bw’ali, naffe bwe tuli mu nsi muno.’ (1 Yokaana 4:17.)

“Ek. Oyinza okulaga ekyokulabirako kimu ng’ekyo kaakano? Ali ludda wa oyo atuukiridde bw’atyo?

“Ok. Eri abamu ababuuza ekibuuzo kino omuntu ayinza okuddamu nti, Singa mmanyi omu wano, sandikubuulidde; kubanga tobuuza lwa kwagala. Ofaanana Kerode; onoonya bunoonya omwana omuto omutte.

“Naye mu ngeri esingako obutereevu tuddamu nti: Waliwo ensonga nnyingi lwaki ebyokulabirako ebitayinza kuwakanyizibwa biba bitono, oba nga tebiriiwo n’akatono. Kino kyandimuleetedde ebizibu ki omuntu oyo yennyini, ng’ateekeddwa ng’akabonero buli muntu k’alasa! Era kyandibadde kya mugaso ki eri abawakanya! ‘Kubanga bwe batagondera Musa ne bannabbi,’ Kristo n’Abatume be, ‘newaakubadde alizuukira okuva mu bafu talibakkirizisa.’

“Ek. Tetutera kubeera na butasiima bwa kyama eri abo bonna aboogera nti balokoleddwa mu kibi kyonna?

“Ok. Kisoboka nnyo nti tuyinza okubeera nabwo, era olw’ensonga eziwerako; ekitundu olw’okufaayo ku bulungi bw’emmeeme, eziyinza okulumizibwa singa bano tebali kye beeyita; ekitundu olw’ekika ky’obuggya obukwekebwa eri abo aboogera ku bye batuuseeko ebisinga ebyaffe; era ekitundu olw’obulwa bwaffe obw’obutonde n’omutima ogutayanguwa kukkiriza mirimu gya Katonda.

“Ek. Lwaki tetuyinza kusigala mu ssanyu ery’okukkiriza okutuusa lwe tutuukirizibwa mu kwagala?

“Ok. Ddala lwaki? kubanga ennaku entukuvu tezikizza ssanyu lino; kubanga ne bwe tuba wansi w’omusaalaba, bwe tuba nga tugabana nnyo ku kubonaabona kwa Kristo, tuyinza okusanyuka n’essanyu eritayogerekeka.”

Okuva mu bitundu bino kirabika awatali kwegaanibwa, si ndowooza yange ne ya muganda wange yokka, wabula n’endowooza y’Ababuulizi bonna abaali bakolagana naffe, mu myaka 1744, 45, 46 ne 47. So sijjukira nti, mu lukuŋŋaana lwonna ku zino, twaliko eddoboozi limu eritakkiriziganya; naye okubuusabuusa kwonna omuntu yenna kwe yabanga nakwo nga tukuŋŋaanye, kwonna kwaggibwangawo nga tetunnayawukana.

18. Mu mwaka 1749, muganda wange yakuba ebitabo bibiri eby’“Ennyimba n’Ebitontome Ebitukuvu.” Olw’okuba saabiraba nga tebinnafulumizibwa, mwalimu ebintu ebimu bye saasiima. Naye nnasiima ddala ennyimba ezisinga obungi ku nsonga eno; ennyiriri ntono ku zo ze zino wammanga :—

Jjangu, Mukama, olabisibwe wano,

Era ozikirize emirimu gyonna egya Setaani;

Kaakano, awatali kibi, labikira mu nze,

Era onjjuze essanyu eritaggwaawo:

Laga amaaso go ag’omukisa;

Okubeerawo kwo lwe lunaku olutuukiridde. (Vol. I., p. 203.)

Yanguwa ojje okunnunula,

Weetwalire owuwo mu kaseera kano;

Kuŋŋaanya omwoyo gwange ogubungeeta guddeyo eka,

Era ogukuume mu mirembe egituukiridde.

Nga tegukyakkirizibwa kutambulatambula

Mu nsi yonna,

Kwata omusibe w’okwagala kwo,

Onsibire mu Katonda! (Olupapula 247.)

Abasibe bo basumulule, Otuwe emirembe gyo;

Era ennaku zaffe n’ebibi byaffe bijja kukoma mu kaseera kamu.

Akaseera ako kabe kaakano! Kkiriza okwegayirira kwaffe,

Ggwe Omununuzi waffe ali kaakano era Omubeezi waffe! (Vol. II., p. 124.)

Nnunula mu kibi kino ekyazaalibwa nakyo;

Ekikoligo kimenyebwe Kaakano;

Onfuule wuwo emirembe gyonna.

Nga ngabana ku butonde bwo obutuukiridde,

Ka mbeere Kaakano mu ggwe

Ekitonde ekiggya, ekitaliiko kibi. (Olupapula 156.)

Nkyusa, Mukama, era onkyuse kaakano,

Omwoyo gwange gukutamye ekikoligo kyo;

Mpa kaakano okuzuula luulu

Ey’omwoyo omuwombeefu era omukkakkamu.

Kkakkanya, Ayi kkakkanya ekifuba kyange ekitabuse;

Ka nfune ekiwummulo ekyo eky’okubiri:

Nkome emirembe gyonna ku mirimu gyange,

Nga ntuukiriziddwa mu butukuvu. (Olupapula 162.)

Jjangu mu ssaawa eno esiimibwa,

Leeta obwakabaka bwo obw’omu ggulu!

Tujjuze amaanyi ag’ekitiibwa;

Ng’okuula ensigo z’ekibi. (Olupapula 168.)

Jjangu, ggwe Omwana gw’Endiga omwagalwa, eyattibwa ku lw’aboonoonyi,

Leeta amazzi agalongoosa;

Kozesa, okunaazaako buli bbala,

Omusaayi gwo ogw’amaanyi.

Ayi, gukke mu mmeeme yaffe

Wansi ng’ekibi kye twazaalibwa nakyo:

Fuula buli mwoyo ogwalumizibwa omulamu,

Na buli mugenge omulongoofu! (Olupapula 171.)

Abasibe ab’essuubi, mugolokoke,

Mulabe Mukama wammwe ng’ajja:

Laba! ku biwaawaatiro by’okwagala abuuka,

Era aleeta okununulibwa okumpi.

Okununulibwa mu musaayi gwe

Abayita okukufuna:

“Mujje gye ndi, Katonda asonyiwa:

Mukkirize,” bw’akoowoola, “mukkirize!”

Yesu, gy’oli gye tutunuulira,

Okutuusa lwe tulokolebwa mu bisigalira by’ekibi,

Ne tugaana ekikoligo ky’omufuzi omukambwe ali munda,

Ne tusuula eri enjegere ze.

Obutonde bwaffe tebukyaddamu

Kutufuga:

Olw’okukkiriza tukwata amaanyi,

Agalirokola emirembe gyonna. (Olupapula 188.)

Yesu, obulamu bwaffe, labikira mu ffe,

Abafa okufa kwo buli lunaku:

Weeyoleke ng’Omumalirizi;

Ssa Omwoyo wo azuukiza!

Bikkula ekyama ekyakwekebwa,

Gaba ekirabo eky’okubiri;

Weeyoleke ggwe ow’ekitiibwa mu nze,

Mu buli mutima ogulindirira. (Olupapula 195.)

Mu Ye tulina emirembe, Mu Ye tulina amaanyi!

Nga tukuumibwa ekisa kye Mu ssaawa yonna ey’ekizikiza,

Mu kukemebwa kwaffe kwonna Atukuuma, okukakasa

Obulokozi bwe obujjuvu ddala, Okujjula kw’okwagala kwe.

Yogera ekigambo eky’essanyu, Otulagire tubeere ba ddembe!

Ayi, tolina, Mukama, Omukisa ku lwange?

Emirembe gye wagaba, Gimpe mu kaseera kano,

Era oggulewo eggulu lyo, Ayi Kwagala, mu mutima gwange! (Olupapula 324.)

Ennyimba zino zaddamu okufulumizibwa omulundi ogwokubiri mu mwaka 1752; era awatali kukyusa kulala kwonna, okuggyako okutereeza ensobi ntono ez’empandiika.

Mpanvuyizza nnyo mu bitundu bino, kubanga okuva mu byo kirabika, awatali kusoboka n’akatono kuwakanyizibwa, nti okutuusa leero nze ne muganda wange twalwanirira, (1.) Nti okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo kwe kwagala okwo eri Katonda n’eri muliraanwa waffe, okutegeeza okununulibwa mu kibi kyonna. (2.) Nti kino kifunibwa lwa kukkiriza kwokka. (3.) Nti kiweebwa mangu ago, mu kaseera kamu. (4.) Nti tulina okukisuubira, si mu kufa, wabula buli kaseera; nti kaakano kye kiseera ekisiimibwa, kaakano lwe lunaku olw’obulokozi buno.

19. Mu Lukuŋŋaana olw’omwaka 1759, bwe twalaba akabi nti endowooza ez’enjawulo ziyinza okuyingira mu ffe mpola nga tetukitegedde, ne twongera okwekenneenya enjigiriza eno mu bujjuvu; era oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera kitono ne nfulumya “Ebirowoozo ku Kutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo,” nga bikulemberwa ekirango kino wammanga: —

“Akatabo kano akaddirira tekagendereddwamu n’akatono kumatiza kwagala kwa muntu yenna okumanya buli kimu. Tekagendereddwamu kukakasa njigiriza eno mu bujjuvu, okuwakanya abo abagigaana n’abagisekerera; nedda, wadde okuddamu ebiwakanya ebingi ebigyogerwako, ebiyinza okuleetebwa n’abantu abassa omwoyo ku by’eddiini. Kye ngenderera wano kyokka, kwe kulangirira obulangirizi endowooza zange ku nsonga eno; okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo kye kuzingiramu, nga bwe nkutegeera, ne kye kutazingiramu; n’okugattako ebirowoozo bitono eby’omugaso n’ebiragiro ebikwata ku nsonga eno.

“Olw’okuba ebirowoozo bino byasooka okukuŋŋaanyizibwa mu ngeri ey’ekibuuzo n’okuddamu, mbirese mu ngeri y’emu. Bye bimu ddala bye mbadde nnina okumala emyaka egisukka amakumi abiri.

“EKIBUUZO. Okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo kye ki?

“OKUDDAMU. Okwagala Katonda n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, n’amagezi, n’emmeeme, n’amaanyi. Kino kitegeeza nti, tewali mpisa nkyamu, tewali ekontana n’okwagala, esigala mu mmeeme; era nti ebirowoozo byonna, n’ebigambo, n’ebikolwa, bifugibwa okwagala okulongoofu.

“Ek. Ogamba nti okutuukirira kuno kugoba obunafu bwonna, n’obutamanya, n’ensobi?

“Ok. Bulijjo ŋŋamba ekikontana ddala n’ekyo, era bwe nnakolanga bulijjo.

“Ek. Naye buli kirowoozo, n’ekigambo, n’omulimu, biyinza bitya okufugibwa okwagala okulongoofu, ng’ate omuntu mu kiseera kye kimu ali wansi w’obutamanya n’ensobi?

“Ok. Wano sirabawo kukontana: ‘Omuntu ayinza okujjuzibwa okwagala okulongoofu, era n’asigala ng’ayinza okukola ensobi.’ Ddala sisuubira kuwonyezebwa nsobi ezikolebwa ddala, okutuusa omubiri guno ogufa lwe gulifuuka ogutafa. Nzikiriza nti kino kiva bulijjo mu kuba nti emmeeme ebeera mu mubiri n’omusaayi. Kubanga kaakano tetuyinza kulowooza n’akatono, okuggyako nga tuyita mu bitundu by’omubiri ebyo ebyabonaabona mu ngeri y’emu n’ekitundu ekirala kyonna eky’obutonde bwaffe. Era n’olwekyo tetuyinza kwewala oluusi okulowooza ekikyamu, okutuusa omubiri guno oguvunda lwe gulifuuka ogutavunda.

“Naye tuyinza okutwala ekirowoozo kino ewala okusingawo. Ensobi mu kusalawo eyinza okuleeta ensobi mu kukola. Ng’ekyokulabirako: Ensobi y’Omwami De Renty ku mbeera y’okwefiiriza, eyava mu ndowooza gye yayigirizibwa, yaleeta ensobi eyo mu kukola, okwesiba omusipi ogw’ekyuma. Era wayinza okubaawo ebyokulabirako lukumi ng’ebyo, ne mu abo abali mu mbeera y’ekisa esingayo waggulu. Naye, Buli kigambo na buli kikolwa bwe biva mu kwagala, ensobi ng’eyo si kibi mu makulu amatuufu. Kyokka, teyinza kugumira bukambwe bw’obwenkanya bwa Katonda, wabula yeetaaga omusaayi ogutangirira.

“Ek. Baganda baffe bonna abaakuŋŋaanira e Bristol mu August, 1758, baasalawo ki ku nsonga eno?

“Ok. Kyayogerwa mu bigambo bino: (1.) Buli muntu ayinza okukola ensobi ebbanga lyonna ly’amala nga mulamu. (2.) Ensobi mu ndowooza eyinza okuleeta ensobi mu kukola. (3.) Buli nsobi ng’eyo kwe kusobya etteeka erituukiridde. N’olwekyo, (4.) Buli nsobi ng’eyo, singa tewaali musaayi gw’okutangirira, yandireese omusango ogw’olubeerera. (5.) Kiddirira nti, abasinga okutuukirira beetaaga obutayosa obulungi bwa Kristo, ne ku lw’ebisobyo byabwe ebya ddala, era bayinza okugamba ku lwabwe bennyini, awamu ne ku lwa baganda baabwe, nti ‘Tusonyiwe ebyonoono byaffe.’

“Kino kinnyonnyola mangu ekyandirabise nga tekinnyonnyolekeka n’akatono; kwe kugamba, nti abo abatanyiiga Bwe twogera ku ddaala ly’okwagala erisingayo waggulu, naye tebaagala kuwulira ku kubeera mu bulamu obutaliimu kibi. Ensonga eri nti, bamanyi nti abantu bonna bayinza okukola ensobi, era mu kukola awamu ne mu kusalawo. Naye tebamanyi, oba tebeetegereza, nti kino si kibi, okwagala bwe kuba nsibuko yokka ey’okukola.

“Ek. Naye era, bwe baba nga babeera mu bulamu obutaliimu kibi, kino tekigoba bwetaavu bwa Mutabaganya? Waakiri, tekyeyoleka nti tebakyetaaga Kristo mu mulimu gwe ogw’obwakabona ?

“Ok. Nedda n’akatono. Tewali bawulira bwetaavu bwabwe bwa Kristo nga bano; tewali bamwesigamako ddala nga bo. Kubanga Kristo tawa mmeeme bulamu nga bwawukanye naye, wabula mu ye era wamu naye. N’olwekyo ebigambo bye bituufu mu ngeri y’emu eri abantu bonna, mu mbeera y’ekisa yonna gye babeeramu: ‘Ng’ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo nga teriri ku muzabbibu, bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze: Awatali’ (oba nga mwawukanye na) ‘Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola.’

“Mu buli mbeera twetaaga Kristo mu ngeri zino wammanga (1.) Ekisa kyonna kye tufuna, kirabo kya bwereere okuva gy’ali. (2.) Tukifuna ng’ekyo kye yagula, olw’omuwendo gwe yasasula gwokka. (3.) Ekisa kino tukirina, si okuva eri Kristo kyokka, wabula mu ye. Kubanga okutuukirira kwaffe tekufaanana kw’omuti, ogukula olw’amazzi agava mu kikolo kyagwo gwokka, wabula, nga bwe kyayogeddwa emabega, kufaanana kw’ettabi, eriba nga ligattiddwa ku muzabbibu, ne libala ebibala; naye, bwe lisalibwako, ne likala ne liwotoka. (4.) Emikisa gyaffe gyonna, egy’ensi eno, egy’omwoyo, n’egy’olubeerera, gyesigamye ku kutwegayiririra kwe, nga kino kye kitundu ekimu eky’omulimu gwe ogw’obwakabona, kye tubeera n’obwetaavu bwakyo bulijjo mu ngeri y’emu. (5.) Abantu abasinga obulungi bakyetaaga Kristo mu mulimu gwe ogw’obwakabona, okutangirira bye baleka okukola, n’obutatuukiriza kwabwe, (ng’abamu bwe boogera mu butuufu,) ensobi zaabwe mu kusalawo ne mu kukola, n’obunafu bwabwe obw’engeri ez’enjawulo. Kubanga bino byonna kuwaba okuva ku tteeka erituukiridde, era n’olwekyo byetaaga okutangirira. Naye nti si bibi mu makulu amatuufu, tutegeera nti kiyinza okulabika okuva mu bigambo bya Pawulo Omutukuvu, ‘Ayagala ng’atuukiriza amateeka; kubanga okwagala kwe kutuukiriza amateeka.’ (Abaruumi 13:10.) Kale, ensobi, n’obunafu bwonna obuva mu mbeera y’omubiri oguvunda, tebukontana n’akatono n’okwagala; era n’olwekyo, mu makulu g’Ebyawandiikibwa, si kibi.

“Okwongera okwennyonnyolako katono ku nsonga eno: (1.) Si kibi kyokka, ekiyitibwa bwe kityo mu butuufu, (kwe kugamba, okumenya mu bugenderevu etteeka erimanyiddwa,) wabula n’ekibi, ekitayitibwa bwe kityo mu butuufu, (kwe kugamba, okumenya etteeka lya Katonda awatali bugenderevu, erimanyiddwa oba eritamanyiddwa,) kyetaaga omusaayi ogutangirira. (2.) Nzikiriza nti tewali kutuukirira ng’okwo mu bulamu buno okugoba okumenya kuno okutali kwa bugenderevu kwe ntegeera nti kuva mu butonde mu butamanya n’ensobi ebitayinza kwawukana na bulamu buno obufa. (3.) N’olwekyo okutuukirira okutaliimu kibi kigambo kye sikozesangako, nneme okulabika nga nneekontana. (4.) Nzikiriza nti, omuntu ajjudde okwagala kwa Katonda akyayinza okumenya etteeka mu ngeri eno etali ya bugenderevu. (5.) Okumenya ng’okwo oyinza okukuyita ebibi, bw’oba oyagala: nze sikuyita bwe ntyo, olw’ensonga ezoogeddwako waggulu.

“Ek. Kubuulirira ki kw’oyinza okuwa abo abakuyita bwe batyo, n’abo abatakuyita bwe batyo?

“Ok. Abo abatakuyita bibi, baleme kulowooza n’akatono nti bo bennyini oba abantu abalala bonna bali mu mbeera nga bayinza okuyimirira mu maaso g’obwenkanya obutakoma awatali Mutabaganya. Kino kiteekwa okulaga oba obutamanya obusingayo obuziba, oba amalala n’okwekulumbaza okusingayo.

“Abo abakuyita bwe batyo, beegendereze baleme kutabula bunafu buno n’ebibi, ebiyitibwa bwe bityo mu butuufu.

“Naye banaakyewala batya? Bino binaayawulibwa bitya ku biri, bwe biba nga byonna biyitibwa ebibi awatali kwawula? Ntya nnyo, singa tukkiriza ebibi byonna okukwatagana n’okutuukirira, batono abandikomye endowooza eyo ku bunafu obwo bwokka, ekigambo ekyo kwe kyandibadde ekituufu.

“Ek. Naye okusobola okukola ensobi kuyinza kutya okukwatagana n’okwagala okutuukiridde? Omuntu atuukirizibwa mu kwagala tali buli kaseera wansi w’amaanyi gaakwo? Era ensobi yonna eyinza okuva mu kwagala okulongoofu?

“Ok. Nziramu nti, (1.) Ensobi nnyingi ziyinza okukwatagana n’okwagala okulongoofu; (2.) Ezimu ziyinza okuva mu kwo nga tekigendereddwamu: Ntegeeza nti, okwagala kwennyini kuyinza okutuleetera okukola ensobi. Okwagala okulongoofu eri muliraanwa waffe, okuva mu kwagala Katonda, tekusiba kibi ku mwoyo, kukkiriza byonna, era kusuubira byonna.
