N’olwekyo beera mwerufu era mwesimbu, bw’ovunaanibwa ekintu kyonna; tonoonya kukyewala wadde okukikweka; wabula kirekere kirabike nga bwe kiri, era bw’otyo tolemesa, wabula oyonja, enjiri.

“Ek. 33. Kubuulirira ki Okwokubiri kw’oyinza okubawa?

“Ok. Mwegendereze omuwala oyo ow’amalala, okwefuula abaluŋŋamizibwa. Ayi mubeere wala nnyo ddala nakwo! Temuwa kifo kulowooza okubuguumirira. Temwanguyiriza kuwa Katonda ebintu. Temulowooza mangu nti ebirooto, amaloboozi, ebiwulirwa mu mutima, okwolesebwa, oba ebibikkulirwa biva eri Katonda. Biyinza okuva gy’ali. Biyinza okuva mu butonde. Biyinza okuva eri Setaani. N’olwekyo, ‘temukkirizanga buli mwoyo, naye mugyetegereze mulabe obanga givudde eri Katonda.’ Mugezese byonna n’ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa, era byonna bikivuunamire. Muli mu kabi ak’okwefuula abaluŋŋamizibwa buli ssaawa, bwe muva ku Byawandiikibwa ne bwe kiba katono nnyo; weewaawo, oba ku makulu ag’olwatu, ag’ebigambo nga bwe biri, ag’ekyawandiikibwa kyonna, nga kitwaliddwa wamu n’ebikyetoolodde. Era bwe mutyo bwe muli, bwe munyooma oba bwe mutassa kitiibwa mu magezi, okumanya, oba okusoma kw’abantu; nga buli kimu ku bino kirabo kirungi nnyo okuva eri Katonda, era kiyinza okuweereza ebigendererwa ebisingayo obulungi.

“Mbawabula, obutakozesanga n’akatono ebigambo, amagezi, okulowooza, oba okumanya, mu ngeri ey’okunyooma. Wabula, musabe nti mmwe bennyini mubibeemu bingi okweyongera n’okweyongera. Bwe muba mutegeeza amagezi ag’ensi, okumanya okutaliimu mugaso, okukubaganya ebirowoozo okw’obulimba, mukyogere bwe mutyo; era musuule ebisusunku, naye si ŋŋaano.

“Ekkubo erimu ery’awamu eriyingiza okwefuula abaluŋŋamizibwa, kwe kusuubira enkomerero awatali kukozesa ngeri; okusuubira okumanya, ng’ekyokulabirako, awatali kunoonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa, n’okwebuuza ku baana ba Katonda; okusuubira amaanyi ag’omwoyo awatali kusaba obutayosa, n’okutunula okunywevu; okusuubira omukisa gwonna awatali kuwulira kigambo kya Katonda buli lwe wabaawo akakisa.

“Abamu baali tebamanyi lukodyo luno olwa Setaani. Baalekera awo okunoonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa. Baagamba nti, ‘Katonda awandiika Ebyawandiikibwa byonna ku mutima gwange. N’olwekyo, sirina bwetaavu bwa kubisoma.’ Abalala baalowooza nti tebaalina bwetaavu bungi bwa kuwulira, bwe batyo ne baddirira mu kugenda mu kubuulira okw’oku makya. Ayi mulabulwe, mmwe abakwatibwako mu kino! Muwulirizza eddoboozi ly’omugenyi. Mudduke mudde eri Kristo, era munywerere mu kkubo eddungi ery’edda, ‘eryaweebwa abatukuvu omulundi gumu;’ ekkubo n’omukaafiiri lye yajulira: ‘Nti Abakristaayo baagolokokanga mu makya buli lunaku okuyimbira Kristo ennyimba nga Katonda.’

“Okwegomba kwennyini ‘okukula mu kisa’ kuyinza oluusi okuba ekkubo eriyingiza okwefuula abaluŋŋamizibwa. Olw’okuba kututwala obutayosa okunoonya ekisa ekiggya, kuyinza okututwala nga tetukitegedde okunoonya ekintu ekirala ekiggya, ng’oggyeeko amadaala amaggya ag’okwagala eri Katonda n’eri abantu. Bwe kityo kwatwala abamu okunoonya era n’okulowooza nti baafuna ebirabo eby’engeri empya, oluvannyuma lw’omutima omuggya, nga, (1.) Okwagala Katonda n’amagezi gaffe gonna; (2.) N’emmeeme yaffe yonna; (3.) N’amaanyi gaffe gonna: (4.) Okufuuka omu ne Katonda: (5.) Okufuuka omu ne Kristo: (6.) Okubeera n’obulamu bwaffe nga bukwekeddwa wamu ne Kristo mu Katonda: (7.) Okufa ne Kristo: (8.) Okuzuukira naye: (9.) Okutuula naye mu bifo eby’omu ggulu: (10.) Okutwalibwa waggulu ku ntebe ye ey’obwakabaka: (11.) Okubeera mu Yerusaalemi Empya: (12.) Okulaba eweema ya Katonda ng’ekka mu bantu: (13.) Okufiira emirimu gyonna: (14.) Obutaba mu kabi ka kufa, bulumi, oba nnaku, oba okukemebwa.

“Ensonga emu ey’ensobi zino nnyingi, kwe kutwala buli kukozesebwa okuggya, okw’amaanyi okw’ekimu ku byawandiikibwa bino ku mutima, okuba ekirabo eky’engeri empya; nga tebamanyi nti ebimu ku byawandiikibwa bino tebinnaba kutuukirira; nti ebisinga obungi ku birala bituukirira bwe tuweebwa obutuukirivu; ebisigadde, mu kaseera ke tutukuzibwa. Kisigala kubiyitamu bubiyitamu mu madaala agasingako waggulu. Kino kyokka kye tulina okusuubira.

“Ensonga endala ey’ensobi zino, n’endala lukumi, kwe kutalowooza n’obuziba, nti okwagala kye kirabo kya Katonda ekisingayo waggulu; okwagala okuwombeefu, okuteefu, okugumiikiriza; nti okwolesebwa kwonna, ebibikkulirwa, okulabisibwa kwonna, bintu bitono bw’obigeraageranya n’okwagala; era nti ebirabo byonna ebyogeddwako waggulu oba bye bimu nakwo, oba biri wansi nnyo ddala wa kwo.

“Kyandibadde kirungi mmwe okutegeera kino mu bujjuvu,—‘eggulu ery’amaggulu kwagala.’ Tewali kintu kisinga waggulu mu ddiini; mu butuufu, tewali kirala; bwe munoonya ekintu kyonna okuggyako okwagala okusingawo, munoonya wala n’ekigendererwa, muva mu kkubo ery’obwakabaka. Era bwe mubuuza abalala nti, ‘Mwafuna omukisa guno oba guli?’ bwe muba mutegeeza ekintu kyonna okuggyako okwagala okusingawo, mutegeeza ekikyamu; mubatwala okuva mu kkubo, era mubateeka ku kkubo ery’obulimba. Kale mukinyweze mu mutima gwammwe, nti okuva mu kaseera Katonda lw’abalokodde mu kibi kyonna, temulina kigendererwa kirala okuggyako okwagala okusingawo okwo okunnyonnyoddwa mu ssuula ey’ekkumi n’essatu ey’Abakkolinso. [1 Abakkolinso 13] Temuyinza kulinnya waggulu wa kino, okutuusa lwe mulitwalibwa mu kifuba kya Ibulayimu.

“Nziramu nate okugamba nti, mwegendereze okwefuula abaluŋŋamizibwa. Kwe kuli, okulowooza nti mulina ekirabo eky’okwogera obunnabbi, oba eky’okwawula emyoyo, kye sikkiriza nti omu ku mmwe akirina; nedda, wadde nti yali akirinako. Mwegendereze okusalira abantu omusango nti batuufu oba bakyamu nga musinziira ku nneewulira yammwe. Lino si kkubo lya Byawandiikibwa ery’okusala omusango. Ayi munywerere ku ‘mateeka ne ku bujulirwa!’

“Ek. 34. Kiki Ekyokusatu?

“Ok. Mwegendereze enjigiriza egaana amateeka (Antinomianism); ‘okuggyawo amateeka,’ oba ekitundu kyonna ku go, ‘olw’okukkiriza.’ Okwefuula abaluŋŋamizibwa kutwala mu kino mu butonde; ddala kumpi tebiyinza kwawukanyizibwa. Kino kiyinza okukuyingirira mu ngeri lukumi, n’okuba nti toyinza kukyegendereza nnyo okusukka. Weegendereze buli kintu, oba mu njigiriza oba mu kukola, ekirina engeri yonna ey’okutwala mu kino. N’amazima ago amakulu, nti ‘Kristo ye nkomerero y’amateeka,’ gayinza okutukyamya ne tugwamu, bwe tutalowooza nti yeetwalira buli nsonga ey’amateeka ag’empisa, n’agisimba mu tteeka ly’okwagala. Mwegendereze okulowooza nti, ’Kubanga nzijudde okwagala, sseetaaga butukuvu bungi bwe butyo. Kubanga nsaba bulijjo, n’olwekyo sseetaaga kiseera kigere kya kusaba mu kyama. Kubanga ntunula bulijjo, n’olwekyo sseetaaga kwekebera kwa njawulo.’ Ka ‘tugulumize amateeka,’ ekigambo kyonna ekyawandiikibwa, ‘era tugawe ekitiibwa.’ Lino libe eddoboozi lyaffe: ‘Ebiragiro byo mbitwala nga bya muwendo okusinga zaabu oba amayinja ag’omuwendo. Ayi, amateeka go nga ngaagala nnyo! olunaku lwonna ngalowoozaako.’ Mwegendereze ebitabo ebigaana amateeka; naddala emirimu gya Dr. Crisp ne Omwami Saltmarsh. Birimu ebintu bingi ebirungi ennyo; era kino kye kibifuula eby’akabi okusingawo. Ayi mulabulwe nga bukyali! Temuzannyisa muliro. Temuteeka mukono gwammwe ku kinnya kya ssalambwa. Mbeegayiridde, mwegendereze okwekkiririzaamu mu ndowooza zammwe ng’abalala mubanyooma. Okwagala kwammwe oba okukola obulungi kwammwe kuleme kukoma ku Bametodisiti, nga bwe bayitibwa, bokka; n’okusingawo ku kitundu ekyo ekitono ennyo ku bo ekirabika nga kyafuulibwa ekiggya mu kwagala; oba ku abo abakkiriza ebigambo byammwe n’ebyabwe. Ayi temukifuula Sibboleesi yammwe! Mwegendereze okusirika okukyamu; okulekera awo mu makulu amakyamu emirimu gyammwe. Okwogera ku kyokulabirako kimu ku bingi: ‘Wafuna,’ bw’agamba omu, ‘omukisa omunene. Naye n’otandika okugwogerako, n’okukola kino ne kiri; bw’otyo n’ogufiirwa. Wandisirise.’

“Mwegendereze okwesanyusa; weewaawo, n’okukufuula empisa ennungi, nga musekerera okwegaana, n’okwetikka omusaalaba buli lunaku, okusiiba oba okwefiiriza. Mwegendereze okunenya buli muntu; okulowooza oba okuyita abo ababawakanya mu ngeri yonna, oba mu ndowooza oba mu kukola, abazibe b’amaaso, abafu, abagudde, oba ‘abalabe b’omulimu.’ Ate nate, mwegendereze enjigiriza ey’okukkiriza kwokka (Solifidianism); nga temuleekaana kirala okuggyako nti, ’Mukkirize, mukkirize!’ nga musalira omusango abo aboogera mu ngeri esinga okukwatagana n’Ebyawandiikibwa nti tebamanyi oba nti b’amateeka. Mu biseera ebimu, ddala, kiyinza okuba ekituufu obutayogera ku kirala okuggyako okwenenya, oba ku kukkiriza kwokka, oba ku butukuvu bwokka; naye, okutwaliza awamu, omulimu gwaffe kwe kulangirira ‘okuteesa kwonna okwa Katonda, n’okwogera obunnabbi nga bwe kukwatagana n’okukkiriza. Ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa kyogera ku butuukirivu bwonna na buli ttabi lyabwo, nga kikka okutuuka ku matabi gaabwo agasingayo obutono; nga okwegendereza, okubeera ow’empisa ennungi, omunyiikivu, omugumiikiriza, okussaamu abantu bonna ekitiibwa. Bw’atyo, era, Omwoyo Omutukuvu akola ekyo kyennyini mu mitima gyaffe, si nga atonda bubeezi okwegomba okw’obutukuvu okutwaliza awamu, wabula nga atusika n’amaanyi eri buli kisa ekya njawulo, ng’atutwala eri buli kitundu kinnakimu ‘ekya buli kyagalibwa.’ Era kino kituufu ddala: Kubanga nga ‘olw’ebikolwa okukkiriza bwe kutuukirizibwa; bwe kityo okutuukiriza oba okuzikiriza omulimu gw’okukkiriza, n’okunyumirwa okusiimibwa, oba okugumira obutasiima, bwa Katonda, byesigamye nnyo ku buli kikolwa kinnakimu eky’obuwulize oba eky’obujeemu.

“Ek. 35. Kiki Ekyokuna?

“Ok. Mwegendereze ebibi eby’okuleka okukola; temufiirwanga kakisa konna ak’okukola obulungi mu ngeri yonna. Munyiikirire ebikolwa ebirungi; temulekanga mu bugenderevu mulimu gwonna, oba ogw’okutya Katonda oba ogw’okusaasira. Mukole obulungi bwonna bwe musobola eri emibiri n’emmeeme z’abantu. Naddala, ‘munno ng’asobezza, omunenyanga, era toganya kibi kubeera ku ye.’ Mubeere banyiikivu. Temuwa kifo bugayaavu wadde obunafu; temuwa nsonga ya kugamba nti, ‘Muli bagayaavu, muli bagayaavu.’ Bangi bajja kukyogera n’okutuusa kaakano; naye omwoyo gwammwe gwonna n’enneeyisa yammwe biwakanye okuwaayiriza okwo. Mubeere bulijjo nga mulina kye mukola; temufiirwa kaseera na katono; mukuŋŋaanye obukunkumuka, waleme kubaawo kibula. Era buli omukono gwo kye gugenda okukola, kikole n’amaanyi go gonna. Mubeere ‘balwa okwogera,’ era mwegendereze mu kwogera. ’Mu bigambo ebingi temubula kwonoona.’ Temwogera nnyo; wadde okumala ebbanga ddene omulundi gumu. Batono abayinza okunyumya mu ngeri ey’omugaso okusukka essaawa emu. Mubeere wala nnyo ddala n’okunyumya okw’eddiini okutaliimu nsa, n’olugambo olw’eddiini.

“Ek. 36. Kiki Ekyokutaano?

“Ok. Mwegendereze okwegomba ekintu kyonna okuggyako Katonda. Kaakano temwegomba kirala; buli kwegomba okulala kugobeddwa; mulabe nti tewali kuddamu kuyingira. ‘Weekuumenga ng’oli mulongoofu;’ ‘eriiso’ lyo lisigale ‘ddamu, n’omubiri gwo gwonna gujja kujjula omusana.’ Temukkiriza kwegomba kwa mmere ewooma, oba essanyu eddala lyonna ery’omubiri; tewabaawo kwegomba kwa kusanyusa liiso oba okulowooza, olw’ekintu kyonna ekikulu, oba ekiggya, oba ekirungi; tewabaawo kwegomba kwa ssente, kwa kutenderezebwa, oba okussibwamu ekitiibwa; kwa ssanyu mu kitonde kyonna. Muyinza okuzzaawo okwegomba kuno; naye temwetaaga; temwetaaga kuddamu kukuwulira. Ayi munywerere mu ddembe eryo Kristo lye yabafuula ab’eddembe.

“Mubeere ebyokulabirako eri bonna, eby’okwegaana, n’okwetikka omusaalaba gwammwe buli lunaku. Balabe nti temutwala nga kintu ssanyu lyonna eritabasembeza kumpi ne Katonda, era nti temufaayo ku bulumi bwonna obubasembeza; nti mugenderera kumusanyusa kwokka, oba mu kukola oba mu kubonaabona; nti olulimi olutakyuka olw’omutima gwammwe, ku bikwata ku ssanyu oba obulumi, ekitiibwa oba obuswavu, obugagga oba obwavu, lwe luno,

‘Byonna bye bimu gye ndi, kasita Mu Mukama wange nnyinza okubeera omulamu n’okufa!’

Ek. 37. Kiki Ekyomukaaga?

“Ok. Mwegendereze okwawukana, okuyuza Ekkanisa ya Kristo. Obutabeera bumu obwo obw’omunda, ebitundu okulekera awo okubeera n’okwagala okw’omu ku munne ‘buli kimu eri ekirala,’ (1 Abakkolinso 12:25,) kye kikolo kyennyini eky’empaka zonna, na buli kwawukana okw’okungulu. Mwegendereze buli kintu ekitwala mu kyo. Mwegendereze omwoyo ogwawukanya; mwewale buli ekirina akabonero akasingayo obutono ak’ekkubo eryo. N’olwekyo, temugamba nti, ‘Nze ndi wa Pawulo oba wa Apolo;’ ekintu kyennyini ekyaleeta okwawukana mu Kkolinso. Temugamba nti, ‘Ono ye Mubuulizi wange; Omubuulizi asingayo obulungi mu England. Mumpe ono, mutwale abalala bonna.’ Bino byonna bigenderera okuzaala oba okusaasaanya okwawukana, okwawukanya abo Katonda be yagatta. Temunyoomanga oba okuvvoola Omubuulizi yenna; temugulumiza omu okusinga abalala, muleme kumulumya ye n’ensonga ya Katonda. Ku ludda olulala, temunyigiriza muntu yenna olw’obutakwatagana oba obutatuukirira mu kwogera; nedda, wadde olw’ensobi ezimu, singa ddala ziba nsobi.

“Mu ngeri y’emu, bwe muba mwagala okwewala okwawukana, mukwate buli tteeka ery’Ekibiina, n’ery’Obubinja, olw’omwoyo. Temulekanga kukuŋŋaana n’Ekibinja kyammwe (Class) oba Akabinja (Band); temubula mu lukuŋŋaana lwonna olw’olwatu. Zino ze nsiba zennyini ez’Ekibiina kyaffe; era buli ekinafuya, oba ekigenderera okunafuya, okufaayo kwaffe ku bino, oba obwegendereza bwaffe mu kubigendamu, kikuba ku kikolo kyennyini eky’okussa kimu kwaffe. Nga omu bw’agamba, ‘Ekitundu ekyo eky’enteekateeka yaffe, enkuŋŋaana ez’ekyama eza buli wiiki ez’okusaba, okwekebera, n’okukubiriza okw’enjawulo, kibadde engeri esingayo obukulu ey’okuzzaamu obuziba n’okunyweza buli mukisa ogwafunibwa olw’ekigambo ekibuulirwa, n’okugusaasaanya eri abalala, abaali tebasobola kugenda mu kubuulira okw’olwatu; so nga, awatali kukwatagana kuno okw’eddiini n’okunyumya, okufuba okusingayo obunyiikivu, olw’okubuulira kwokka, kulabise nga tekuliimu mugaso gwa lubeerera.’

“Temukkiriza kirowoozo na kimu eky’okwawukana ku baganda bammwe, oba endowooza zaabwe zikwatagana n’ezammwe oba nedda. Temulooteranga nti omuntu yenna ayonoona olw’obutabakkiriza, olw’obutakkiriza kigambo kyammwe; oba nti endowooza eno oba eri yeetaagisa ddala eri omulimu, era nti byombi biteekwa kuyimirira oba kugwa wamu. Mwegendereze obutagumira kuwakanyizibwa. Temusalira musango oba okulowooza obubi ku abo abatayinza kulaba nga mmwe bwe mulaba, oba abalowooza nti obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe kubawakanya, oba mu kintu ekinene oba ekitono. Ntya nti abamu ku ffe tulowoozezza obubi ku balala, olw’okuba bawakanyizza kye twagamba kyokka. Bino byonna bitwala mu kwawukana; era, olwa buli kintu eky’engeri eno, tubayigiriza essomo ebbi ku ffe ffennyini.

“Ayi mwegendereze okunyiiga amangu, okuba ab’ekiruyi, obutagumira kwogerwako; okwekanga olw’ekigambo ekisingayo obutono; n’okudduka abo abatakkiriza bulungi bigambo byange oba eby’omulala awatali kwebuuza!

“Musuubire okuwakanyizibwa n’okulwanyisibwa, awamu n’emisaalaba egy’engeri ez’enjawulo. Mulowooze ku bigambo bya Pawulo Omutukuvu: ‘Kubanga mwaweebwa, ku lwa Kristo,’—ku lulwe, ng’ekibala ky’okufa kwe n’okubegayiririra kwe,—‘si mu kumukkiriza kyokka, naye n’okubonaabona ku lulwe.’ (Abafiripi 1:29.) Mwaweebwa! Katonda abawa okulwanyisibwa kuno oba okuvumibwa; kabonero kaggya ak’okwagala kwe. Era munaagaana Omugabi; oba munaanyooma ekirabo kye, ne mukitwala ng’ekibonoobono? Temwandisinze kugamba nti, ‘Kitange, ekiseera kituuse, ogulumizibwe: Kaakano owa omwana wo okubonaabona ekintu ku lulwo: Nkola nga bw’oyagala?’ Mumanye nti ebintu bino, nga tebiri biziyiza eri omulimu gwa Katonda, oba eri emmeeme yammwe, okuggyako olw’ensobi yammwe, si bitayinza kwewalika kyokka mu nteekateeka ya Katonda, wabula bya mugaso, weewaawo, byetaagisa, gye muli. N’olwekyo, mubifune okuva eri Katonda (so si mu mukisa obukisa) n’omutima gumu, n’okwebaza. Mubifune okuva eri abantu n’obuwombeefu, obuteefu, okukkiriza, obugonvu, obuwoomi. Lwaki n’endabika yammwe ey’okungulu n’enneeyisa yammwe tebiyinza kuba bigonvu? Mujjukire empisa ya Lady Cutts: ‘Kyayogerwa ku Kabaka w’Abaruumi Tito nti, Tewali muntu n’omu eyava gy’ali ng’anyiize. Naye kyandyogeddwa ku ye nti, Tewali muntu n’omu eyagenda gy’ali ng’anyiize: Bwe batyo bonna bwe baali bakakafu ku kwaniriza okw’ekisa era okw’okusiima kwe bandisanze gy’ali.’

“Mwegendereze okukema abalala okwawukana nammwe. Temuwa kyesittaza kyonna ekiyinza okwewalika; mulabe nti enneeyisa yammwe mu byonna ekwatagana n’ekyo kye mwatula, nga muyonja okuyigiriza kwa Katonda Omulokozi waffe. Mwegendereze naddala nga mwogera ku mmwe bennyini: Ddala temuyinza kwegaana mulimu gwa Katonda; naye mugwogereko, bwe muyitibwa okukikola, mu ngeri esingayo obutanyiiza. Mwewale ebigambo byonna eby’ekitiibwa ekingi, eby’okwekuza; ddala temwetaaga kugutuuma linnya lya wamu; si kutuukirira, okutukuzibwa, omukisa ogwokubiri, wadde okuba nga mukutuuseeko. Wabula mwogere ku bintu kinnakimu Katonda by’abakoledde. Muyinza okugamba nti, ‘Mu kiseera ekyo nnawulira enkyukakyuka gye siyinza kunnyonnyola; era okuva mu kiseera ekyo, siwuliranga malala, oba okwekkiririzaamu, oba obusungu, oba obutakkiriza; wadde ekintu kyonna okuggyako okujjula kw’okwagala eri Katonda n’eri abantu bonna.’ Era muddemu buli kibuuzo ekirala eky’olwatu ekibuuzibwa n’obwetoowaze n’obwangu.

“Era omu ku mmwe bw’aba nga mu kiseera kyonna agudde okuva ku ekyo ky’ali kaakano, bw’ayinza okuddamu okuwulira amalala oba obutakkiriza, oba empisa yonna gy’amaze okununulibwamu kaakano; tekyegaana, tokikweka, tokibikkako n’akatono, si kulwa ng’oteeka emmeeme yo mu kabi. Mu mbeera yonna genda eri omuntu gw’oyinza okwesiga, omutegeeze ekyo kyennyini ky’owulira. Katonda alimusobozesa okwogera ekigambo mu kiseera kyakyo, ekiriba obulamu eri emmeeme yo. Era mazima Aliddamu okuyimusa omutwe gwo, era aliretera amagumba agaamenyebwa okusanyuka.

“Ek. 38. Kubuulirira ki okw’enkomerero kw’oyinza okubawa?

“Ok. Mubeere ebyokulabirako mu byonna; naddala mu bintu eby’okungulu, (nga mu kwambala,) mu bintu ebitono, mu kukozesa ssente zammwe, (nga mwewala buli nsimbi esaasaanyizibwa awatali nsonga,) mu kussa omwoyo ku by’eddiini okw’obuziba era okunywevu, ne mu bunywevu n’omugaso gw’okunyumya kwammwe kwonna. Bwe mutyo bwe mulibeera ‘ettabaaza eyaka mu kifo eky’ekizikiza.’ Bwe mutyo bwe muli ‘kukula mu kisa’ buli lunaku, okutuusa ’lwe muliyanirizibwa n’essanyu lingi nnyo mu bwakabaka obutaggwaawo obwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.’

“Okubuulirira okusinga obungi okwogeddwako emabega kunywezebwa n’amaanyi mu birowoozo bino wammanga; bye mbawa amagezi okufumiitirizaako n’obuziba era emirundi mingi, nga mumaze Ebyawandiikibwa ebitukuvu:—

“(1.) Ennyanja ky’ekifaananyi ekirungi ennyo eky’okujjula kwa Katonda, n’okw’Omwoyo ow’omukisa. Kubanga ng’emigga gyonna bwe giddayo mu nnyanja; bwe kityo emibiri, emmeeme, n’ebikolwa ebirungi eby’abatuukirivu, biddayo mu Katonda, okubeera omwo mu kiwummulo kye ekitaggwaawo.

“Newakubadde ng’ebirabo byonna eby’ekisa kya Katonda byesigamye ku bugabi bwe bwokka, naye emirundi mingi asiima okubigatta ku kusaba, ku kuyigiriza, ne ku butukuvu bw’abo be tubeera nabo. Olw’okusika okw’amaanyi naye okutalabika Asika emmeeme ezimu okuyita mu kukolagana kwazo n’ezirala.

“Okukwatagana okw’emitima okukolebwa ekisa kusinga nnyo okwo okukolebwa obutonde.

“Abeewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda balaga nti enneewulira zikulukuta mu butonde okuva mu kwagala okwa mazima nga bwe zikulukuta okuva mu kwagala okw’obulimba; bwe batyo bwe bawulira ennyo ebirungi n’ebibi eby’abo be baagala ku lwa Katonda. Naye kino kiyinza kutegeerwa abo bokka abategeera olulimi lw’okwagala.

“Entobo y’emmeeme eyinza okubeera mu kiwummulo, ne bwe tuba mu bizibu bingi eby’okungulu; nga entobo y’ennyanja bw’eba nkkakkamu, ng’ate kungulu waayo kuyuuguumizibwa nnyo.

“Ebiyamba ebisinga obulungi okukula mu kisa kwe kuyisibwa obubi, okuswazibwa, n’okufiirwa ebitutuukako. Tusaanidde okubifuna n’okwebaza kwonna, ng’ebisinga ebirala byonna, ne bwe kiba olw’ensonga eno yokka,—nti okwagala kwaffe tekuliiko kye kukolamu.

“Ekkubo erisinga obwangu ery’okuwona okubonaabona kwaffe, kwe kukkiriza kumale ebbanga lyonna Katonda ly’asiima.

“Bwe tugumira okuyigganyizibwa n’okubonyaabonyezebwa mu ngeri entuufu, tutuuka ku kigero ekisinga obunene eky’okufaanana Kristo, olw’okukozesa obulungi ekimu ku biseera bino, okusinga bwe twandikoze nga tukoppa bukoppa okusaasira kwe, mu bikolwa ebirungi ebingi.

“Obumu ku bukakafu obusingayo obukulu obw’okwagala kwa Katonda eri abo abamwagala, kwe kubaweereza okubonaabona, n’ekisa eky’okukugumira.

“Ne mu kubonaabona okusingayo obunene, tusaanidde okutegeeza Katonda, nti, nga tukufuna okuva mu mukono gwe, tuwulira essanyu wakati mu bulumi, olw’okubonyaabonyezebwa Oyo atwagala, era gwe twagala.

“Ekkubo erisinga obwangu Katonda ly’akozesa okusembeza omuntu gy’ali, kwe kumubonyaabonya mu kyo ky’ayagala ennyo, era olw’ensonga ennungi; n’okuleetera okubonaabona kuno okuva mu kikolwa ekirungi ekikoleddwa n’eriiso eddamu; kubanga tewali kiyinza kumulaga mu lwatu okusingawo obwereere bw’ebyo ebisinga okwagalibwa n’okwegombebwa mu nsi.

“(2.) Okwewaayo okwa mazima kuli mu kukwatagana ddala ne byonna Katonda by’ayagala; ayagala era akola byonna (okuggyako ekibi) ebibaawo mu nsi. Okusobola okutuuka ku kino tulina kwaniriza bwaniriza buli ekibaawo, ekirungi n’ekibi, nga Ye by’ayagala.

“Mu kubonaabona okusingayo obunene okuyinza okutuuka ku batuukirivu, oba okuva mu ggulu oba ku nsi, basigala nga tebanyeenya mu mirembe, era nga bagondedde ddala Katonda, olw’okumutunuulira okw’omunda okw’okwagala, okugatta mu kimu amaanyi gonna ag’emmeeme zaabwe.

“Tusaanidde okugumira mu kasirise buli ekitutuukako, okugumira obunafu bw’abalala n’obwaffe, okubwatula eri Katonda mu kusaba okw’ekyama, oba mu kusinda okutayogerekeka; naye obutayogera kigambo kya bukaawu oba kya kwemulugunya, wadde okwemulugunya oba okwekaanya; wabula nga twagala ddala Katonda akuyise mu ngeri gy’asiima. Tuli baana b’endiga be, era n’olwekyo tusaanidde okuba abeetegefu okubonaabona, okutuusa ne ku kufa, awatali kwemulugunya.

“Tulina okugumiikiriza abo be tutayinza kutereeza, n’okumatira okubawaayo eri Katonda. Kuno kwe kwewaayo okwa mazima. Era olw’okuba Ye yagumira obunafu bwaffe, kituufu naffe okugumira obunafu bw’omu ku munne ku lulwe.

“Okuleka byonna, okweyambulamu byonna, olw’okunoonya n’okugoberera Yesu Kristo nga tuli bwereere okutuuka e Besirekemu, gye yazaalibwa; bwereere okutuuka mu kisenge gye yakubirwa embooko; era bwereere okutuuka e Kalvaliyo, gye yafiira ku musaalaba, kusaasira kunene nnyo, n’okuba nti ekintu ekyo, wadde okukimanya, tebiweebwa muntu yenna, okuggyako olw’okukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda.

“(3.) Tewali kwagala Katonda awatali kugumiikiriza, era tewali kugumiikiriza awatali buwombeefu n’obuwoomi bw’omwoyo.

“Obwetoowaze n’okugumiikiriza bwe bukakafu obusingayo okwesigika obw’okweyongera kw’okwagala.

“Obwetoowaze bwokka bwe bugatta okugumiikiriza n’okwagala; awatali bwo tekisoboka kuggya mugaso mu kubonaabona; oba ddala, okwewala okwemulugunya, naddala bwe tulowooza nti tetuwaddeyo nsonga yonna olw’ebyo abantu bye batubonyaabonyamu.

“Obwetoowaze obwa mazima kika kya kwegaana ddala nti tetuli kintu; era kino kye kifo ekya wakati eky’empisa ennungi zonna.

“Emmeeme ekomyewo eri Katonda esaanidde okufaayo ku buli ekyogerwa gy’ali, ku nsonga y’obulokozi, n’okwegomba okukiggyamu omugaso.

“Ku bibi Katonda by’asonyiye, waleme kusigalawo kirala okuggyako obwetoowaze obusingako obuziba mu mutima, n’obwegendereza obusingako mu bigambo byaffe, mu bikolwa byaffe, ne mu kubonaabona kwaffe.

“(4.) Okugumiikiriza abantu, n’okugumira ebibi mu buteefu ne mu kasirise, gwe mugatte gw’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo.

“Katonda ye wa kusooka okwagalibwa: Omulimu gwakwo oguddako, kwe kugumiikiriza obunafu bw’abalala. Era tusaanidde okutandika okukikola wakati mu ba mu nnyumba yaffe.

“Tusaanidde okusinga okulaga okwagala kwaffe eri abo abasinga okunyiiza oba engeri yaffe ey’okulowooza, oba empisa yaffe, oba okumanya kwaffe, oba okwegomba kwe tulina, nti abalala babeere n’empisa ennungi nga ffe bwe twagala okubeera.

“(5.) Katonda kumpi tawa Mwoyo we ne eri abo b’anywezezza mu kisa, bwe batamusaba mu buli mbeera, si omulundi gumu gwokka, wabula emirundi mingi.

“Katonda takola kintu kyonna okuggyako ng’addamu okusaba; era n’abo abaakyusibwa ne bakomawo eri Katonda nga bo bennyini tebasabye, (ekitatera n’akatono kubaawo,) tebaali awatali kusaba kw’abalala. Buli buwanguzi obuggya emmeeme bw’efuna kiva mu kusaba okuggya.

“Buli lwe tuwulira nga tetuli bulungi, tusaanidde okugenda mu kusaba, tulyoke tuwe ekifo ekisa n’omusana gwa Katonda, n’oluvannyuma ne tusalawo, awatali kweraliikirira ku ngeri gye binaatambulamu.

Mu kukemebwa okusingayo obunene, okutunuulira Kristo omulundi gumu, n’okwatula obwatuzi erinnya lye, kimala okuwangula omubi, kasita kikolebwa n’obwesige n’obukkakkamu bw’omwoyo.

Ekiragiro kya Katonda ‘okusabanga obutayosa’ kyesigamye ku bwetaavu bwe tulina obw’ekisa kye okukuuma obulamu bwa Katonda mu mmeeme, obutayinza kubaawo akaseera n’akamu awatali kyo, okusinga omubiri bwe guyinza okubaawo awatali mpewo.

Oba tulowooza ku; oba twogera ne, Katonda, oba tukola oba tubonaabona ku lulwe, byonna kusaba, bwe tuba nga tetulina kigendererwa kirala okuggyako okwagala kwe, n’okwegomba okumusanyusa.

“Byonna Omukristaayo by’akola, ne mu kulya ne mu kwebaka, kusaba, bwe bikolebwa mu bwesimbu, nga Katonda bw’alagira, awatali kubigattako oba okubikendeezaako ku bubwe.

“Okusaba kugenda mu maaso mu kwegomba kw’omutima, newakubadde ng’okutegeera kuli ku bintu eby’okungulu.

“Mu mmeeme ezijjudde okwagala, okwegomba okusanyusa Katonda kwe kusaba obutayosa.

“Nga obukyayi obw’ekiruyi Setaani bw’atukyawa bwe buyitibwa okuwuluguma kw’empologoma, bwe kityo okwagala kwaffe okw’amaanyi kuyinza okuyitibwa okukaabirira Katonda.

“Katonda kye yetaaga kyokka ku baana be abakuze, kwe kuba nti emitima gyabwe girongooseddwa ddala, era nti bamuwa obutayosa okwegomba n’obweyamo ebiva mu butonde mu kwagala okutuukiridde. Kubanga okwegomba kuno, nga bye bibala ebya ddala eby’okwagala, kwe kusaba okusingayo okutuukirira okuyinza okuva mu kwo.

(6.) Kumpi tekitegeerekeka ekkubo Katonda mw’atwalira abo abamugoberera bwe liri ffunda; n’engeri gye tuteekwa okumwesigamako, okuggyako nga tubulwa obwesigwa gy’ali.

“Kumpi tekikkirizika ebintu ebisingayo obutono bwe biba n’obukulu bungi mu maaso ga Katonda; n’ebizibu ebinene ebiddirira oluusi ebyo ebirabika ng’ebisobyo ebitono.

Nga enfuufu ntono ennyo bw’eyonoona essaawa, n’omusenyu ogusingayo obutono ne gubikka okulaba kwaffe, bwe kityo akakunkumuka akasingayo obutono ak’ekibi akali ku mutima kalemesa okutambula kwagwo okutuufu okudda eri Katonda.

“Tusaanidde okubeera mu kkanisa ng’abatukuvu bwe bali mu ggulu, era mu nnyumba ng’abantu abasingayo obutukuvu bwe bali mu kkanisa; nga tukola emirimu gyaffe mu nnyumba nga bwe tusaba mu kkanisa; nga tusinza Katonda okuva mu ntobo y’omutima.

“Tusaanidde okufuba obutayosa okusalako ebintu byonna ebitaliimu mugaso ebitwetoolodde; era Katonda emirundi mingi asalako ebisukkiridde eby’emmeeme zaffe mu kigero kye kimu nga ffe bwe tusalako eby’emibiri gyaffe.

“Engeri esingayo obulungi ey’okuziyiza Setaani, kwe kuzikiriza buli eky’ensi ekisigadde mu ffe, tulyoke tuzimbire Katonda, ku bifunfugu byakyo, ennyumba ey’okwagala kwokka. Olwo tulitandika, mu bulamu buno obuyitawo, okwagala Katonda nga bwe tulimwagala mu biseera ebitaggwaawo.

“Kumpi tetutegeera nga kyangu okunyaga Katonda ekimusaanira, mu mukwano gwaffe n’abantu abasingayo empisa ennungi, okutuusa okufa lwe kubatuggyako. Naye okufiirwa kuno bwe kuleeta ennaku ey’olubeerera, obwo bukakafu obweyolefu nti twalina emabega eby’obugagga bibiri, mwe twagabanyiza omutima gwaffe.

“(7.) Bwe tumala okuleka byonna, ne tutatunula butayosa, ne tutasaba Katonda okugatta obwegendereza bwaffe n’obubwe, tujja kuddamu okusibibwa n’okuwangulwa.

“Nga empewo esingayo akabi bw’eyinza okuyingira mu bituli ebitono, bwe kityo Setaani tayingirira mu ngeri esinga akabi okusinga mu bintu ebitono ebitetegerezebwa, ebirabika nga si kintu, naye nga bigguka mpola omutima eri okukemebwa okunene.

“Kirungi okwefuula abaggya, buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera, nga twekebejja n’obwegendereza embeera y’emmeeme zaffe, nga gy’obeera tetukikolangako emabega; kubanga tewali kisinga kuyamba eri obukakafu obujjuvu obw’okukkiriza, okusinga okwekuuma mu ngeri eno mu bwetoowaze, ne mu kukola ebikolwa ebirungi byonna.

“Ku kutunula n’okusaba obutayosa kusaanidde okugattibwako okubeera n’eky’okukola obutayosa. Kubanga ekisa kidduka ekifo ekyereere nga obutonde bwe bukidduka; era Setaani ajjuza buli Katonda ky’atajjuza.

“Tewali bwesigwa ng’obwo obusaanidde okubeera wakati w’omukulembeze w’emmeeme n’omuntu gw’akulembera. Basaanidde okutunuuliragana obutayosa mu Katonda, n’okwekebejja n’obwegendereza, oba ebirowoozo byabwe byonna birongoofu, n’ebigambo byabwe byonna biluŋŋamizibwa n’amagezi ag’Ekikristaayo. Ensonga endala bintu bya bantu byokka; naye bino bintu bya Katonda mu ngeri ey’enjawulo.

“(8.) Ebigambo bya Pawulo Omutukuvu, ‘Tewali ayinza kuyita Yesu Mukama, okuggyako olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu,’ bitulaga obwetaavu bw’okutunuulira Katonda mu bikolwa byaffe ebirungi, ne mu birowoozo byaffe ebisingayo obutono; nga tumanyi nti tewali kimusanyusa, okuggyako ebyo by’atonda mu ffe era wamu naffe. Okuva mu kino tuyiga nti tetuyinza kumuweereza, okuggyako ng’akozesa olulimi lwaffe, emikono, n’omutima, okukola ku bubwe ne ku bw’Omwoyo we kyonna ky’ayagala tukole.

“Singa tetwali banafu ddala, ebikolwa byaffe ebirungi byandibadde bintu byaffe; so nga kaakano bya Katonda ddala, kubanga biva gy’ali ne mu kisa kye: Bw’asitula emirimu gyaffe, n’agifuula gyonna egy’obwakatonda, yeegulumiza mu ffe okuyita mu gyo.

“Erimu ku mateeka amakulu ag’eddiini, kwe obutafiirwa kakisa konna ak’okuweereza Katonda. Era, olw’okuba tatulabika na maaso, tulina okumuweereza mu muliraanwa waffe; ky’akkiriza nga gy’obeera kikoleddwa ye yennyini, ng’ayimiridde mu maaso gaffe ng’alabika.

“Katonda tayagala bantu abatali banywevu, wadde ebikolwa ebirungi ebikolebwa ne biyimirira. Tewali kimusanyusa, okuggyako ekyo ekifaanana obutakyuka bwe.

“Okufaayo obutayosa ku mulimu Katonda gw’atukwasa kabonero ka kutya Katonda okunywevu.

“Okwagala kusiiba bwe kusobola, era nga bwe kusobola. Kutwala mu biragiro byonna ebya Katonda, era kwemalira ku mirimu gyonna egy’okungulu gye kusobola. Kubuuka, nga bwe kiri, nga Eriya ku lusenyi, okusanga Katonda ku lusozi lwe olutukuvu.

“Katonda mukulu nnyo, n’okuba nti awa obukulu ekintu ekisingayo obutono ekikolebwa olw’okumuweereza.

“Balina omukisa abo abalwala, weewaawo, oba abafiirwa obulamu bwabwe, olw’okukola omulimu omulungi.

“Katonda emirundi mingi akweka ekitundu abaana be kye bakola mu kukyusa emmeeme endala. Naye omuntu ayinza okugamba n’obuvumu nti, omuntu oyo amala ebbanga eddene ng’asinda mu maaso ge olw’okukyuka kw’omulala, emmeeme eyo buli lw’ekyusibwa n’edda eri Katonda, y’emu ku nsonga ezisingayo obukulu ez’ekyo.

“Okwagala okugaba tekuyinza kukolebwa bulungi, okuggyako nga, Ekisooka, tukukola mu kaseera ddala Katonda lw’atuwa akakisa; era, Eky’okubiri, ne tugenda mu kaseera akaddako okukuwaayo eri Katonda olw’okwebaza okw’obwetoowaze. Era kino olw’ensonga ssatu: Ekisooka, okumuddiza kye twafuna okuva gy’ali. Eky’Okubiri, okwewala okukemebwa okw’akabi okuva mu bulungi bwennyini obw’ebikolwa bino. N’Eky’Okusatu, okwegatta ne Katonda, emmeeme mw’egaziyizibwa mu kusaba, n’ebirabo byonna eby’ekisa bye twafuna, n’ebikolwa ebirungi bye twakola, okuggya gy’ali amaanyi amaggya okulwanyisa ebibi ebiyinza okuva mu bikolwa bino byennyini mu ffe, bwe tutakozesa ddagala Katonda lye yateekawo eri obutwa buno. Engeri entuufu ey’okujjuzibwa nate obugagga bw’ekisa kwe kukyeyambulamu bwe tutyo; era awatali kino kizibu nnyo obutakoowa mu kukola ebikolwa ebirungi.

“Ebikolwa ebirungi tebifuna kutuukirira kwabyo okw’enkomerero, okutuusa lwe, nga bwe kiri, bibulira mu Katonda. Kuno kika kya kufa gye biri, ekifaanana okw’emibiri gyaffe, egitalituuka ku bulamu bwagyo obusingayo waggulu, obutafa bwagyo, okutuusa lwe giribulira mu kitiibwa ky’emmeeme zaffe, oba okusingawo ekya Katonda, kye girijjuzibwa. Era kye kyokka ebikolwa ebirungi kye biba n’eky’ensi era ekifa, kye bifiirwa olw’okufa kuno okw’omwoyo.

“Omuliro kabonero ka kwagala; era okwagala kwa Katonda ye nsibuko era ye nkomerero y’ebikolwa byaffe byonna ebirungi. Naye amazima gasinga ekifaananyi; era omuliro gw’okwagala okw’obwakatonda gulina omugaso guno okusinga omuliro ogw’omu nsi, nti guyinza okuddayo waggulu eri ensibuko yaagwo, ne gusitula wamu nagwo okugenda eyo ebikolwa byonna ebirungi bye guleeta. Era mu ngeri eno guziyiza okwonoonebwa kwabyo olw’amalala, okwemanya obwereere, oba okutabulwamu okubi kwonna. Naye kino tekiyinza kukolebwa mu ngeri ndala okuggyako okufuula ebikolwa bino ebirungi okufa mu ngeri ey’omwoyo mu Katonda, olw’okwebaza okw’obuziba, okunnyika emmeeme mu ye nga mu buziba obutakoma, ne byonna by’eri, ne kisa kyonna n’ebikolwa by’emubanjibwa; okwebaza, emmeeme mwe yeefaanana ng’eyeerumbulamu byo, biryoke biddeyo eri ensibuko yaabyo, ng’emigga bwe gyefaananya ng’egyagala okweyiwa, bwe gyeyiwa n’amazzi gaagyo gonna mu nnyanja.

“Bwe tufuna ekirabo kyonna okuva eri Katonda, tusaanidde okugenda, oba si mu bisenge byaffe, mu mitima gyaffe, ne tugamba nti, ‘Nzize, Mukama, okukuddiza kye wampa; era nkirekera ddala n’omutima gumu, okuyingira nate mu butaba kintu bwange. Kubanga ekitonde ekisingayo okutuukirira mu ggulu oba ku nsi kiki mu maaso go, okuggyako ekifo ekyereere ekiyinza okujjuzibwa ggwe era okuyita mu ggwe; ng’empewo, eyereere era ey’ekizikiza, bw’eyinza okujjuzibwa omusana gw’enjuba, eguggyawo buli lunaku n’egukomyawo enkeera, nga tewali kintu kyonna mu mpewo ekyetwalira omusana guno oba ekiguziyiza? Ayi mpa obwangu obwo bwe bumu obw’okufuna n’okukuddiza ekisa kyo n’ebikolwa ebirungi! Ŋŋamba nti, ebibyo; kubanga nzikiriza nti ekikolo mwe biva kiri mu ggwe, so si mu nze.’”

fields.title: Ebitundu 26-28
fields.body_html:
26. Mu mwaka 1764, bwe nnaddamu okwetegereza ensonga yonna, ne mpandiika omugatte gw’ebyo bye nnali ndabye mu bigambo bino ebimpi wammanga: —

“(1.) Waliwo ekintu ekiyitibwa okutuukirira; kubanga kyogerwako emirundi n’emirundi mu Byawandiikibwa.

“(2.) Tekujja mangu ng’okuweebwa obutuukirivu; kubanga abaweebwa obutuukirivu balina ‘okweyongerayo okutuuka ku kutuukirira.’ (Abaebbulaniya 6:1.)

“(3.) Tekulwa okutuuka ku kufa; kubanga Pawulo Omutukuvu ayogera ku bantu abalamu abaali batuukiridde. (Abafiripi 3:15.)

“(4.) Si kwa nkomeredde. Okutuukirira okw’enkomeredde si kwa muntu, wadde kwa bamalayika, wabula kwa Katonda yekka.

“(5.) Tekufuula muntu atasobya: Tewali atasobya, ebbanga lyonna ly’asigala mu mubiri.

“(6.) Tekuliimu kibi? Tekisaanira kuwakanira kigambo. Kwe ‘kulokolebwa mu kibi.’

“(7.) Kwe ‘kwagala okutuukiridde.’ (1 Yokaana 4:18.) Buno bwe bukulu bwakwo; engeri zaakwo, oba ebibala byakwo ebitayinza kwawukana nakwo, kwe kusanyuka ennaku zonna, okusaba obutayosa, n’okwebaza mu buli kintu. (1 Basessaloniika 5:16,&c.)

“(8.) Kuyinza okweyongera. Kuli wala nnyo n’okubeera ku kifo ekimu ekitayinza kwawulwamu, n’obutasobola kweyongera, n’okuba nti oyo atuukirizibwa mu kwagala ayinza okukula mu kisa mangu nnyo okusinga bwe yakulanga emabega.

“(9.) Kuyinza okubula, kuyinza okufiirwa; tulina ebyokulabirako bingi eby’ekyo. Naye twali tetunnakakasa kino mu bujjuvu, okutuusa emyaka etaano oba mukaaga egiyise.

“(10.) Bulijjo kukulemberwa era kuddirirwa omulimu ogukolebwa mpolampola.

“(11.) Naye mu kwo kwokka kujja mangu ago oba nedda? Mu kwekenneenya kino, ka tutambule mpola mpola.

“Enkyukakyuka ey’amangu ago ekoleddwa mu bakkiriza abamu: Tewali ayinza kwegaana kino.

“Okuva ku nkyukakyuka eyo, banyumirwa okwagala okutuukiridde; bawulira kino, era kino kyokka; ‘basanyuka ennaku zonna, basaba obutayosa, era beebaza mu buli kintu.’ Kale, kino kyokka kye ntegeeza mu kutuukirira; n’olwekyo, bano bajulirwa b’okutuukirira kwe mbuulira.

“‘Naye mu bamu enkyukakyuka eno teyajja mangu ago.’ Tebaalaba kaseera we yakolerwa. Emirundi mingi kizibu okulaba akaseera omuntu w’afiira; naye waliwo akaseera obulamu we bukoma. Era ekibi bwe kiba nga kikoma, kiteekwa okubaawo akaseera akasembayo ak’okubaawo kwakyo, n’akaseera akasooka ak’okununulibwa kwaffe mu kyo.

“‘Naye bwe baba nga balina okwagala kuno kaakano, bajja kukufiirwa.’ Bayinza; naye tekibagwanira. Era oba bakufiirwa oba nedda, bakulina kaakano; kaakano bayitamu kye tuyigiriza. Kaakano bonna kwagala; kaakano basanyuka, basaba, era batendereza obutayosa.

“‘Kyokka, ekibi kiyimiriziddwa bwimirizibwa mu bo; tekizikiriziddwa.’ Kiyite nga bw’oyagala. Bonna kwagala leero; era tebeeraliikirira bya nkya.

“‘Naye enjigiriza eno ekozeseddwa bubi nnyo.’ Era bw’etyo n’ey’okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza. Naye eyo si nsonga ya kuleka eno wadde enjigiriza endala yonna ey’Ebyawandiikibwa. ‘Bw’onaaza omwana wo,’ nga omu bw’agamba, ‘suula amazzi; naye tosuula mwana.’

“‘Naye abo abalowooza nti baalokolebwa mu kibi bagamba nti tebeetaaga bulungi bwa Kristo.’ Bagamba ekikontana ddala n’ekyo. Olulimi lwabwe luli,—

‘Buli kaseera, Mukama, neetaaga Obulungi bw’okufa kwo!’ Tebabangako emabega n’okukakasa okw’obuziba bwe kutyo, okutayogerekeka bwe kutyo, okw’obwetaavu bwa Kristo mu mirimu gye gyonna nga bwe bakulina kaakano.

“N’olwekyo, Ababuulizi baffe bonna basaanidde okufuba okubuulira okutuukirira eri abakkiriza obutayosa, n’amaanyi, era mu lwatu; n’abakkiriza bonna basaanidde okussa omwoyo ku kintu kino kimu, n’okukulwanirira obutayosa.”

27. Kaakano nkoze kye nnali ngenderera. Mpadde ennyinyonnyola ey’olwatu era ennyangu ey’engeri gye nnasooka okukkiriza enjigiriza y’okutuukirira, n’amakulu mwe nnagikkiririza, era mwe ngikkiririza, era mwe ngiyigiririza okutuusa leero. Ndangiridde byonna na buli kitundu ky’ekyo kye ntegeeza mu kigambo ekyo eky’Ebyawandiikibwa. Nkuubye ekifaananyi kyakwo mu bujjuvu bwakyo, awatali kukweka wadde okubikkako. Era kaakano nandyagadde okubuuza omuntu yenna atasaliriza, Kiki ekiri mu kino eky’entiisa bwe kityo? Okuleekaana kuno kwonna kuva wa, okumaze emyaka gino amakumi abiri n’okusingawo nga kukolebwa mu bwakabaka bwonna; nga gy’obeera Obukristaayo bwonna buzikiriziddwa, n’eddiini yonna ekuuliddwamu n’emirandira? Lwaki erinnya lyennyini ery’okutuukirira lisuuliddwa mu kamwa k’Abakristaayo; weewaawo, ne ligaanibwa era ne likyayibwa, nga gy’obeera lirimu obukyamu obusingayo okuzikiriza? Lwaki Ababuulizi baakwo bakubiddwa enduulu, ng’embwa ezaalalukwa, n’abantu abatya Katonda; weewaawo, n’abamu ku baana baabwe bennyini, abamu be baali, wansi wa Katonda, bazadde okuyita mu njiri? Nsonga ki eriwo ey’ekyo, oba kyekwaso ki? Ensonga; ensonga entuufu, tewali. Tekisoboka kubaawo. Naye ebyekwaso biriwo, era bingi nnyo ddala. Ddala, waliwo ensonga ey’okutya nti, eri abamu abatuyisa bwe batyo, kyekwaso bwekwaso; nti tekisinga kufaanana kw’amaaso gaabwe, okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Baayagala, baanoonya, ensonga ku nze; era wano ne basanga kye baali banoonya. “Eno ye njigiriza ya Omwami Wesley! Abuulira okutuukirira!” Abuulira; naye eno si njigiriza ye okusinga bw’eri eyiyo, oba ey’omuntu omulala yenna, ali Omuweereza wa Kristo. Kubanga eno njigiriza Ye, ya Ye mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, ey’amaanyi; y’enjigiriza ya Yesu Kristo. Ebyo bigambo bye, si byange: Esesthe oun teleioi, hosper ho pater hymon ho en tois ouranois teleios esti,—“Kale mulibeera abatuukiridde, nga Kitammwe ali mu ggulu bw’ali omutuukiridde.” Era ani agamba nti, temulibeera; oba, waakiri, si okutuusa emmeeme yammwe lw’eyawukana ku mubiri? Y’enjigiriza ya Pawulo Omutukuvu, enjigiriza ya Yakobo Omutukuvu, ya Peetero Omutukuvu, ne Yokaana Omutukuvu; era si ya Omwami Wesley mu ngeri endala, okuggyako nga bw’eri enjigiriza ya buli muntu abuulira enjiri ennongoofu era enjiri yonna. Mbategeeza, mu lwatu nga bwe nnyinza okwogera, wa era ddi lwe nnagizuula. Nnagizuula mu bigambo bya Katonda, mu Ndagaano Enkadde n’Empya; bwe nnabisoma nga sirina kigendererwa kirala wadde okwegomba okulala okuggyako okulokola emmeeme yange. Naye enjigiriza eno ne bw’eba ya ani, mbegayiridde, kabi ki akali mu yo? Mugitunuulire nate; mugyekenneenye ku buli ludda, era n’okufaayo okusingayo. Mu ngeri emu, bwe bulongoofu bw’ekigendererwa, okuwaayo obulamu bwonna eri Katonda. Kwe kuwa Katonda omutima gwaffe gwonna; kwe kwegomba kumu n’ekigendererwa kimu okufuga empisa zaffe zonna. Kwe kuwaayo, si kitundu, wabula emmeeme yaffe yonna, omubiri, n’ebintu eri Katonda. Mu ngeri endala, y’endowooza yonna eyali mu Kristo, etusobozesa okutambula nga Kristo bwe yatambula. Kwe kukomolebwa kw’omutima okuva mu bucaafu bwonna, mu kwonoonebwa kwonna okw’omunda awamu n’okw’okungulu. Kwe kufuula omutima omuggya mu kifaananyi kyonna ekya Katonda, okufaanana ddala Oyo eyagutonda. Mu ngeri endala nate, kwe kwagala Katonda n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, ne muliraanwa waffe nga ffe bwe tweyagala. Kale, mukitwale mu ngeri yonna ku zino gye mwagala, (kubanga tewali njawulo nkulu,) era kuno kwe kutuukirira kwonna era kwokka, ng’omuddiring’anwa gw’ebiwandiiko bwe gukakasa mu ngeri etawakanyizika, kwe mbadde nzikiriza era kwe mbadde njigiriza okumala emyaka gino amakumi ana, okuva mu mwaka 1725 okutuuka mu mwaka 1765.

28. Kale okutuukirira kuno kulabike mu ngeri yaakwo ey’obutonde, era ani ayinza okukwogerako ekigambo kimu ekikuwakanya? Waliwo aŋŋanga kwogera bubi ku kwagala Mukama Katonda waffe n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, ne muliraanwa waffe nga ffe bwe tweyagala? ku kufuula omutima omuggya, si mu kitundu kyokka, wabula mu kifaananyi kyonna ekya Katonda? Ani oyo agenda okwasamya akamwa ke ku kunaazibwako okwonoonebwa kwonna okw’omubiri n’okw’omwoyo; oba ku kubeera n’endowooza yonna eyali mu Kristo, n’okutambula mu byonna nga Kristo bwe yatambula? Muntu ki, eyeeyita Omukristaayo, alina obuvumu okuwakanya okuwaayo, si kitundu, wabula emmeeme yaffe yonna, omubiri, n’ebintu eri Katonda? Muntu ki assa omwoyo ku by’eddiini eyandiwakanyizza okuwa Katonda omutima gwaffe gwonna, n’okubeera n’ekigendererwa kimu ekifuga empisa zaffe zonna? Nziramu nate okugamba nti, okutuukirira kuno kulabike mu ngeri yaakwo ddala, era ani agenda okukulwanyisa? Kuteekwa okusooka okukwekebwa nga tekunnawakanyizibwa. Kuteekwa okusooka okubikkibwako eddiba ly’eddubu, oba n’ensolo enkambwe ez’abantu kumpi tezigenda kusindikirizibwa kukutaagulataagula. Naye bano ne bwe bakola kye bakola, abaana ba Katonda baleme kuddamu kulwanyisa kifaananyi kya Katonda. Ebitundu bya Kristo bireme kwogera kintu kyonna ku kubeera n’endowooza yonna eyali mu Kristo. Abo abalamu eri Katonda baleme kuwakanya kuwaayo bulamu bwaffe bwonna gy’ali. Lwaki ggwe alina okwagala kwe okufukiddwa mu mutima gwo wandiwakanyizza okumuwa omutima gwo gwonna? Byonna ebiri munda mu ggwe tebikaaba nti, “Ayi, ani ayagala ayinza okwagala ekimala?” Kya nnaku nnyo nti abo abaagala era abagenderera okumusanyusa babeere n’ekigendererwa ekirala kyonna oba okwegomba! n’okusingawo, nti batye, ng’obulimba obuzikiriza, weewaawo, bakyawe ng’eky’omuzizo eri Katonda, okubeera n’okwegomba kuno kumu n’ekigendererwa ekifuga buli mpisa! Lwaki abantu abeewaddeyo eri Katonda bandityeyo okuwaayo emmeeme zaabwe zonna, emibiri, n’ebintu eri Katonda? Lwaki abo abaagala Kristo bandikitwaze ng’ensobi esaanira okusalirwa omusango, okulowooza nti tuyinza okubeera n’endowooza yonna eyali mu ye? Tukkiriza, tulwanirira, nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu bwereere olw’obutuukirivu n’omusaayi gwa Kristo. Era lwaki mutunyiigira nnyo bwe mutyo, kubanga tusuubira n’okutukuzibwa ddala olw’Omwoyo we? Tetusuubira kusiimibwa okuva eri abaddu b’ekibi ab’olwatu, wadde okuva eri abo abalina ekifaananyi ky’eddiini kyokka. Naye mulituusa ddi mmwe abasinza Katonda mu mwoyo, “abakomolebwa okukomolebwa okutaakolebwa na mikono,” okutegeka olutalo lwammwe ku abo abanoonya okukomolebwa kw’omutima okujjuvu, abalumwa ennyonta okunaazibwako “buli kintu ekyonoona omubiri n’omwoyo,” n’“okutuukiriza obutukuvu mu kutya Katonda?” Tuli balabe bammwe, kubanga tusuubira okununulibwa okujjuvu okuva mu “ndowooza ey’omubiri oyo omulabe wa Katonda?” Nedda, tuli baganda bammwe, bakozi bannammwe mu nnimiro y’emizabbibu eya Mukama waffe, banammwe mu bwakabaka ne mu kugumiikiriza kwa Yesu. Newakubadde nga kino tukyatula, (bwe tuba abasirusiru mu kino, naye mutugumiikirize ng’abasirusiru,) tusuubira ddala okwagala Katonda n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, ne muliraanwa waffe nga ffe bwe tweyagala. Weewaawo, tukkiriza ddala, nti mu nsi muno alirongoosa bw’atyo ebirowoozo by’emitima gyaffe, olw’okuluŋŋamya kw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, tulyoke tumwagale mu ngeri etuukiridde, era tugulumize erinnya lye ettukuvu nga bwe kimusaanira.”

EBIROWOOZO EBIMPI KU KUTUUKIRIRA OKW’EKIKRISTAAYO

EBIROWOOZO ebimu byanzijidde ku makya ga leero ku kutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo, n’engeri n’ekiseera eky’okukufuna, bye ndowooza nti kiyinza okuba eky’omugaso okubiwandiika.

1. Mu kutuukirira ntegeeza okwagala okuwombeefu, okuteefu, okugumiikiriza eri Katonda, n’eri muliraanwa waffe, okufuga empisa zaffe, ebigambo, n’ebikolwa.

Sizingiramu butasobola kukuvaako, oba mu kitundu oba kwonna. N’olwekyo, nzigyawo ebigambo ebiwerako mu Nnyimba zaffe, ebyogera ekitundu, era ebitegeeza ekitundu, obutasobola ng’obwo.

Era sirwanirira kigambo ekitaliimu kibi, newakubadde nga sikiwakanya.

2. Ku bikwata ku ngeri. Nzikiriza nti okutuukirira kuno bulijjo kukolebwa mu mmeeme olw’ekikolwa ekyangu eky’okukkiriza; n’olwekyo, mu kaseera kamu.

Naye nzikiriza omulimu ogukolebwa mpolampola, nga akaseera ako tekannatuuka n’oluvannyuma lwako.

3. Ku bikwata ku kiseera. Nzikiriza nti akaseera kano emirundi mingi ke kaseera ak’okufa, akaseera emmeeme nga tennava mu mubiri. Naye nzikiriza nti kuyinza okuba emyaka kkumi, abiri, oba ana nga tekunnatuuka.

Nzikiriza nti emirundi mingi kuba emyaka mingi oluvannyuma lw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu; naye nti kuyinza okubaawo mu myaka etaano oba emyezi etaano oluvannyuma lwakwo, simanyi nsonga emalirivu ekikontana.

Bwe kiba nti kuteekwa okuba emyaka mingi oluvannyuma lw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, nandyagadde okumanya emeka. _Pretium quotus arroget annus?_ [Ekigambo kino ekyajulizibwa okuva eri Horace Boscawen akivvuunula bw’ati:—“Myaka emeka egiwa ennyiriri zaffe obuyinza?”—Edit.]

Era ennaku emeka oba emyezi, oba n’emyaka, omuntu yenna z’ayinza okukkiriza okubeera wakati w’okutuukirira n’okufa? Kulina kubeera wala kyenkana wa n’okuweebwa obutuukirivu; era kumpi kyenkana wa n’okufa?

LONDON, Jan. 27, 1767.

[Kyalongoosebwa George Lyons ku lwa Wesley Center for Applied Theology e Northwest Nazarene College (Nampa, ID).]
